title: Applied Scientist, AVM Builder Enablement
descriptionHtml:
Applied Scientists on the AWS Vulnerability Management (AVM) Builder Enablement team use program analysis, machine learning and generative AI for managing vulnerabilities and securing the software supply chain across AWS. Our scope covers the third-party open-source packages, language ecosystems, operating systems and kernels that AWS services are built on. Our goal is to take builders out of the remediation loop. When a vulnerability is disclosed or a package is compromised, our systems work out whether it actually affects AWS, generate the fix, check that it's safe and ship it at AWS scale, with one click or no clicks at all.

New vulnerabilities are disclosed every day in the software AWS depends on, and finding and fixing them by hand doesn't scale. We build systems that detect vulnerabilities and work out whether the vulnerable code can actually be reached and exploited in a given service. They rank issues by real risk rather than raw severity scores, then fix them automatically. That can mean upgrading dependencies across ecosystems like Java, Python, JavaScript, Go and Rust, fixing breaking API changes, backporting patches, or patching operating systems and kernels across the fleet. Just as important, we check that each fix is correct and safe, so it can merge with little or no human review.

Beyond known vulnerabilities, we protect the integrity of the software supply chain itself. Modern software is assembled more than it is written, and every dependency is a potential way in for attackers. Securing it means knowing what's in our software, where it came from and whether it can be trusted. Our work here includes building and analyzing software bills of materials (SBOMs), verifying package provenance and build integrity, and detecting malicious or compromised packages before they reach production.

Our methods range from static and dynamic program analysis to LLM-based agents for code repair and upgrades. This is a chance to shape a fast-growing area that directly affects the security of AWS and its customers. You'll apply your technical depth in a fast-moving environment, and your work will reach thousands of AWS builders and services.

Key job responsibilities
• Design and build scientific approaches to vulnerability management. This includes vulnerability detection, reachability and exploitability analysis, dependency resolution, and prioritizing risk across third-party packages, operating systems and kernels.
• Build program analysis techniques (static analysis, dataflow and call-graph analysis, binary and source analysis) that tell us precisely whether a vulnerability affects a given service or host.
• Apply generative AI and agentic coding methods to fix vulnerabilities automatically. Examples include upgrading dependencies, fixing breaking API changes, backporting patches and migrating code across language versions.
• Develop ways to check that automated fixes are correct and safe, such as test generation, behavior-equivalence checking, build and runtime checks, and confidence scoring, so changes can merge with little or no human review.
• Own the design, experiments and delivery of well-defined science problems from start to finish. Turn ambiguous problems into measurable experiments and deliver solutions with measurable impact, such as faster time to fix, higher fix success rates and fewer false positives.
• Work with engineers to turn research prototypes into production systems that run reliably across AWS's codebases and fleet.
• Work with security, OS and kernel, and builder-tools partner teams to understand their remediation challenges and data. Find opportunities where science can make a difference.
• Stay current with research in software security, program analysis, and ML for code. Contribute to internal and external publications where appropriate.
• Share your knowledge through design reviews, documentation and mentoring of junior scientists and engineers.

About the team
The AWS Vulnerability Management (AVM) Builder Enablement team protects AWS from security risks in the software it depends on. Our mission is to take builders out of the remediation loop. We find the issues that matter, fix them automatically and ship the fixes safely at AWS scale. Scientists and engineers on the team work side by side, turning research in program analysis and generative AI into production systems that reach thousands of AWS builders.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we prioritize health, safety, and well-being above all else. There is nothing more important. To support this priority, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Site Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with the site level operations team for your designated site in order to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and Kaizen events, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in Amazon’s processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our associates.

In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial. You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals at your designated site. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs.

title: Sr Structural Analysis Engineer, Leo Structural Analysis Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

This senior Structural Analysis Engineer will lead the structural analysis and verification of a satellite subsystem or major structural area, with deep expertise in dynamics. They must have a strong background in spacecraft structural development and understand the balance between engineering judgment and analysis rigor, and when each is appropriate. They will be able to contribute from day one, defining the approach when requirements and interfaces are not fully defined, and raising the quality of the team's analysis through the methods, tools, and reviews they put in place.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
- Lead structural analysis and verification of a satellite subsystem or major structural area, from requirements through qualification
- Define requirements, interfaces, analysis approaches, and verification strategies from incomplete or evolving direction
- Lead dynamic analysis and test planning: derive component loads and test levels from launch vehicle and system loads, determine qualification and acceptance margins, and plan random vibration, sine, shock, and acoustic verification
- Own and verify subsystem and system-level FEMs, and correlate models to test data
- Document stress analysis substantiating engineering drawings and documents, and review the analysis of other engineers for rigor and consistency
- Support test execution, analyze results, and close out verification of structural requirements
- Support production and operations through analysis of non-conformances, failure investigations, and improvements, working with MRB and liaison partners on complex dispositions
- Drive configuration development and trade studies with clear decision criteria
- Work with suppliers, manufacturing, test, and systems engineering to align on loads, interfaces, and verification
- Create and improve analysis methods, tools, and processes that reduce repeat issues across the team
- Mentor and develop engineers, and lead technical discussions in internal and external design reviews, technical interchange meetings (TIMs), and program gates (PDR/CDR)

A day in the life
This Sr Structural Analysis Engineer will be a technical leader and subject matter expert for their area of the satellite. They will balance hands-on analysis with mentoring and review: building and checking FEMs, completing classical hand calculations, performing dynamic strength analysis, correlating models with test results, and interfacing with design, test, and supplier teams. They will represent Structural Integrity and Analysis in cross-functional forums to align on structural design and verification approaches.

About the team
The Structural Analysis team is responsible for Structural Integrity of not only the spacecraft but all supporting flight and ground support hardware across the program, inside and outside of the Mechanical Engineering group.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or an equivalent field
- 8+ years of experience with aircraft, spacecraft, or launch vehicle structures, including leading the structural analysis and verification of a subsystem or major structural area
- Proven experience in dynamic structural analysis and testing: modal analysis, random vibration, sine sweep/burst, mechanical shock, and acoustic environments; deriving component loads and test levels from launch vehicle and system loads; and test-analysis correlation and model validation
- Vehicle load path definition, development of free-body diagrams, and strength analysis (metallic and/or composite structures)
- Classical aerospace analytical sizing methods, including analysis of stability-critical structures and bolted joint calculations (preload, joint stiffness, shear-tension interaction, bearing-bypass)
- Finite element analysis codes (Femap, Nastran, Ansys, or Abaqus), including FEM modeling techniques such as boundary conditions, element types, structural idealization, bolted connections, contact, and verification methods
- Experience with system Finite Element Model (FEM) management and integrating subsystem FEMs
- Experience developing analysis tools, processes, and documentation standards that other engineers use
- Documentation of analyses through formal structural analysis reports (stress memos, substantiation reports, verification closure documents)
- Demonstrated ability to define requirements, interfaces, and verification approaches when direction is incomplete or evolving, and to mentor other engineers

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or an equivalent field
- Knowledge of SMC-S-016 (Test Requirements for Launch, Upper-Stage, and Space Vehicles) or equivalent military/commercial test standards, including the philosophy of qualification and acceptance test levels, durations, and margins
- Experience with force limiting and notching for vibration testing
- Experience with static load testing of structures, including test planning, instrumentation, and correlation of results to analysis
- Experience with composite and metallic damage tolerance methods (e.g., fatigue, crack growth, residual strength, no-growth approaches)
- Experience leading supplier or vendor engagements on structural analysis deliverables and FEMs
- Track record of delivering structural analysis packages on aggressive schedules in a high-rate production environment
- Experience with rapid iteration and design-for-manufacturing considerations in structural analysis
- Experience in the design of complex mechanical products and equipment at volume
- CAD experience - Siemens NX or equivalent

title: Sr Software Engineer, Amazon Now
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building India's Quick Commerce offering — Amazon Now — delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes. We build world-class technology that powers store launches at scale, curates hyper-local selection, and drives seamless operations across our network. We are looking for a seasoned Software Development Engineer to serve as the senior technical leader for the team, owning the architecture and engineering direction across all of our charters — with a primary focus on the Selection experience: how we curate, manage, and scale the right assortment for every customer, in every city. This is a high-impact role where your technical decisions directly fuel Amazon Now's expansion across India. You will set the technical bar for the team, drive the hardest design problems end-to-end, and multiply the impact of every engineer around you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical strategy and architecture for Selection — curating city-specific assortments, managing per-store catalogs, and simplifying the experience of listing and onboarding new items at scale
- Provide senior technical oversight across all of the team's charters — store launches, catalog and selection, inventory, picking, staging, and store operations — ensuring architectural coherence across them
- Architect systems that onboard new stores rapidly across cities, and that scale reliably to hundreds of stores while maintaining low operational latencies
- Lead the hardest design decisions end-to-end: evaluate trade-offs, simplify complexity, and set patterns the rest of the team builds on
- Mentor and coach engineers, raise the technical bar, and drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team
- Partner closely with product, operations, and business teams to translate ambiguous, complex business problems into durable technical solutions
- Champion operational excellence (CI/CD, monitoring, on-call), lead design reviews, and own a high quality bar for all deliverables

A day in the life
You'll review operational metrics to ensure system health across live stores, unblock engineers on their toughest technical challenges, and dive deep into system designs — weighing trade-offs and cutting complexity. You'll lead design reviews across the team's charters, mentor engineers on architecture patterns, and shape deployment plans for features rolling out across multiple cities, ensuring rollback strategies, monitoring, and alarms are in place before launch. As a senior, you'll help set technical direction and priorities, with Selection as your primary canvas.

About the team
Amazon Now builds the technology behind India's Quick Commerce experience — from the moment a store goes live, to how selection is curated for each neighborhood, to how every order is picked and staged for delivery in minutes. We work at the intersection of technology and physical retail, solving hard problems in real-time inventory, catalog and selection management, store automation, and partner enablement. Our work reaches millions of customers who count on us for everyday essentials, fast.

This role is the senior technical anchor of the team, setting architectural direction across every charter we own — with Selection as the primary focus. It's a rare scope: deep ownership of one of our most important problem spaces, combined with technical influence across the whole team.

We embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have employee-led affinity groups reaching thousands of employees globally. We are dedicated to supporting new members through mentorship and knowledge sharing, and we strive to assign opportunities that help each team member develop into a well-rounded contributor.

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWS Industries
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Professional Services (ProServe) Telco, Media & Entertainment, Gaming and Sports (TMEGS) Delivery Practice is seeking a Sr. Engagement Manager (EM) to own the delivery of complex, outcome-based cloud and AI programs for our customers. In this role you are accountable for business outcomes, not just project milestones. You will help shape what we commit to, negotiate it with customer executives, and deliver it profitably.

Most of our engagements are delivered on a fixed-price, outcome-based model. You will turn customer ambitions into measurable outcomes, clear acceptance criteria and a milestone plan that both the customer and AWS can stand behind. You will work with sales and solution architects before signature to make sure what we sell is deliverable. After signature, you will manage scope, change and commercial performance with discipline: tracking earned value, protecting margin, and negotiating trade-offs with customer executives when priorities shift. You are comfortable having difficult conversations early, and you know how to protect both the customer relationship and the commercial position.

You will lead delivery teams that use AI throughout the delivery lifecycle, from requirements and design through code generation, testing and operations, to deliver outcomes faster and at higher quality than traditional approaches. You are hands-on with AI-assisted delivery tools, and fluent enough in architecture and engineering to challenge AI-generated plans and designs, make informed trade-offs on performance, security, scalability and cost, and keep quality high as delivery speed increases. You apply AWS frameworks such as Well-Architected and the Cloud Adoption Framework, and you build automated quality gates so standards hold as delivery scales.

Our largest programs combine AWS builders with AWS Partner Network (APN) partners and sometimes customer-selected system integrators. You will orchestrate this mixed workforce to a single quality bar. That means setting clear accountability, consistent acceptance criteria and mechanisms that make standards hold by design rather than by inspection. You will also drive change management on the customer side, so the organization adopts what we build and the business value is realized.

You will build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders up to C-level, report progress in terms of business value delivered, and spot leading indicators of risk such as velocity, environment stability, partner quality and team health, acting on them before they become escalations. As you grow, you will lead larger multi-workstream programs, help shape how we price and measure outcomes, and contribute reusable assets, patterns and AI-enabled practices that make the next engagement faster than the last. You are expected to achieve and maintain relevant AWS certifications, including in AI, and to develop deep domain expertise.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud and AI initiatives. We provide a collection of offerings that help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption, and focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies and industries.


Key job responsibilities
- Owning delivery of complex, outcome-based cloud and AI programs end to end, accountable for customer business outcomes, delivery quality and commercial performance
- Working with sales and solution architects before signature to shape scope, define measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria, and confirm what we commit to is deliverable
- Negotiating scope, milestones and trade-offs with customer executives, and managing fixed-price engagements through disciplined change control, earned-value tracking and margin protection
- Managing engagement revenue and financial health: forecasting revenue against milestones, maintaining an accurate estimate at completion, driving timely milestone acceptance and billing, and identifying expansion opportunities that grow the customer relationship
- Leading delivery teams that use AI across the lifecycle (requirements, design, code generation, testing and operations), and applying enough technical depth to challenge AI-generated output and make informed trade-offs on security, performance, scalability and cost
- Orchestrating mixed teams of AWS builders, AWS Partner Network partners and customer-selected integrators to a single quality bar, with clear accountability, consistent acceptance criteria and automated quality gates
- Driving customer-side change management and adoption, so the organization realizes the value of what we build
- Reporting progress to senior stakeholders in terms of business value delivered, and acting on leading indicators of risk (velocity, environment stability, partner quality, team health) before they become escalations
- Contributing reusable assets, patterns and AI-enabled delivery practices that make each engagement faster and more repeatable than the last


About the team
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Principal Program Manager, Regulatory Programs, Regulatory and Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon operates a gig economy and on-demand delivery platform, and the regulatory landscape governing this space is evolving rapidly across all countries we operate. We are looking for a Senior Regulatory Specialist to support our Americas regulatory portfolio (US, Canada, Mexico, Brazil). This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants to sit at the intersection of external regulatory developments, internal compliance, and product/program evolution — and who thrives in complex, fast-moving environments where the stakes are real and the work has direct business impact.

Key job responsibilities
You will track and monitor the full lifecycle of regulatory work across our Americas. That lifecycle has three dimensions:
• You will track regulatory developments across Americas, assess their business impact, and contribute to shaping policy outcomes through engagement with policymakers and regulators.
• When legislation passes or regulations are issued, you will own the translation of regulatory requirements into concrete product and operational changes. You will define what needs to be built, coordinate with engineering and operational teams, and drive delivery against deadlines.
• Once a compliance program is live, you will track that it stays compliant. You will manage structured reviews, assess how business changes interact with existing regulatory obligations, and respond to regulatory inquiries from government agencies.
You will also manage regulatory data obligations, coordinating responses to government data requests, ensuring accuracy and integrity of regulatory submissions, and maintaining visibility into our data reporting footprint across Americas.

This role requires someone who can operate across all of these dimensions simultaneously, prioritize effectively under competing deadlines, and communicate complex regulatory topics to stakeholders.

title: Cluster Service Technician, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
Summary

The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they're the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you'll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.

Shift Pattern: This role includes working in non-traditional shift pattern, which may include nights and weekends



Key job responsibilities
- Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
- Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
- Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
- Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites



A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You'll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites' equipment to make sure it's working safely. As an RME Technician, you'll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You'll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you'll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You'll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we're known for.

As a Cluster Technician, you'll be assigned a nodal home site that serves as your primary base. However, the role includes an element of travel within your designated cluster of sites. This means you'll move between locations as needed to provide maintenance support, respond to breakdowns, and carry out planned preventative work across multiple facilities. This travel element ensures our sites receive consistent, high-quality technical coverage and gives you the opportunity to broaden your experience across a variety of operational environments.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

Basic qualifications

- NVQ Level 3 in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics, or completed a 4-year UK certified apprenticeship
- SVQ Level 3 (or equivalent) in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics, or completed a 4-year UK certified apprenticeship
- Valid Full UK Driving License is Essential

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- Experience with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and safety standards
- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance

title: Head of Mass & Influencer Marketing, LATAM (Spanish Fluent) – Amazon Cross-Border, WW International and Prime Shopping
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced, Spanish-fluent marketing leader to build and run Mass Marketing, Social Media, and Influencer Marketing for Amazon's Worldwide Cross-Border (XB) business across Latin America. In partnership with XCM (Cross-Channel Marketing), you will own the full-funnel brand, media planning, and demand agenda for XB LATAM and other strategic destinations, building awareness, consideration, and conversion at scale. You will also serve as the single-threaded leader for social and influencer marketing across the region.

This role sits at the intersection of brand building and performance. You will lead mass marketing for XB LATAM (starting in Colombia, with Peru, Argentina, and Chile to follow) and other strategic destinations, and drive social and influencer programs across every funnel stage. You will manage a multi-million dollar annual budget that is growing quickly, and oversee agency partnerships throughout the region.

Role Context & Opportunity

Cross-Border Exports and Amazon Bazaar are among the fastest-growing opportunities in Amazon's International Shopping portfolio. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role that will shape how customers across LATAM discover and engage with Amazon.

You will build a scalable mass, social, and influencer marketing engine, launching full-funnel programs in new destinations while protecting efficiency and brand consistency across a multi-country agency ecosystem. You will partner with Data, Science, and Research teams to build measurement models tailored to XB customers, so every dollar can be tied to the business results it drives. Professional experience in the LATAM region is a strong plus.



Key job responsibilities
1. Mass Marketing
• Serve as the XB marketing lead for Colombia mass marketing, working in close partnership with XCM (Cross-Channel Marketing) to plan and execute brand and demand-building campaigns.
• Localize central XCM creative concepts and HVE assets (e.g., Prime Day, Prime Big Deal Days) for the Colombian market, partnering with Global Studios on fast, on-brand creative adaptation.
• Own the Colombia mass-marketing media plan across TV, OLV, digital, and other channels, directing media planning and buying partners (e.g., OMG / Omnicom Colombia) to deliver reach and efficiency targets.
• Lead integrated HVE campaign planning and in-market execution, aligning mass marketing with O&O, Fuse, and Prime Video motions.

2. Social Media & Influencer Marketing — All XB LATAM Destinations (full funnel)

Lead social media and influencer marketing across all XB LATAM destinations, owning strategy and execution across the full funnel:
• Upper funnel (awareness): Drive brand awareness and reach through social-first brand campaigns and mega/macro-influencer partnerships; build culturally relevant content that establishes Amazon in each destination.
• Mid funnel (consideration): Grow consideration and engagement via always-on social content, mid-tier creators, and category/HVE storytelling that moves customers toward intent.
• Lower funnel (conversion): When channel is ready, own performance-oriented influencer and affiliate (Associate) programs, driving sign-ups, installs, and orders; manage conversion-focused creator partnerships and promotional mechanics.
• Define the regional social & influencer strategy, channel mix, and content calendar; set destination-level playbooks that scale from Colombia to new LATAM markets.
• Manage always-on influencer investment (e.g., CO & PE) alongside HVE bursts, selecting the right mix of mega-, macro-, mid-, and micro-influencers per objective.

3. Budget Ownership
• Own and steward a multi-million dollar annual marketing budget across mass, social, and influencer workstreams in LATAM.
• Allocate investment across funnel stages, destinations, and HVEs to maximize efficiency (e.g., cost per acquisition, OPS lift, share of site), and reallocate dynamically based on performance.
• Partner with Finance and BI on budget planning (OP1/OP2), monthly tracking, and ROI reporting.

4. Agency Partnership Management — LATAM

• Own agency relationships across LATAM — media (e.g., OMG / Omnicom), influencer (e.g., Tatam), creative, and social partners — setting scopes, SLAs, and performance expectations.
• Lead agency briefing, selection, contracting support, and quarterly business reviews; hold partners accountable to deliverables, timelines, and efficiency.
• Standardize ways of working and reporting across country agencies to ensure quality and consistency as the footprint expands.

5. Measurement, Reporting & Stakeholder Management
• Define KPIs and measurement frameworks for mass, social, and influencer; partner with BI to instrument reporting and attribute impact across the funnel.
• Deliver weekly/monthly performance readouts and HVE retrospectives with clear insights and recommendations.
• Represent XB LATAM marketing in cross-functional forums, aligning with XCM, Prime, PV, category, and country teams.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish

Preferred qualifications

- Experience creating and executing integrated marketing lead generation campaigns using tactics that include live or virtual events, webinars, email, lead nurture programs, and CRM/sales insights
- Experience with Salesforce and Tableau

title: Senior Financial Analyst, NACF

Come be part of this tremendous organization and join a dedicated team committed to operational and financial excellence where you will focus on the inputs, think like an owner and where every day is Day One.

Our team supports various North America teams through translating operational KPIs into financial impact to ensure our stakeholders have the most up to date and reliable information to make the best possible decision for Amazon. Key job responsibilities

• End-to-end ownership of the financial planning cycles which include forecast modeling, bridging, network partnership and presentations to senior leadership.
• Perform projects financial validations to ensure accurate return-on-investment insights.
• Collect, analyze and manage quantitative data and create meaningful reports to lead business improvement and defect cost reduction strategy.
• Perform root cause analysis to uncover core issues using data, then assisting the operation stakeholders to improve and create new measures for sites productivity.
• Invent and simply processes to drive efficiency and cost improvement over finance processes related to defect costs.
• Thinking big to deliver scalable solutions to better understand end-to-end cost and identify new improvement opportunities.

If you love diving into details, solving problems at the root, and building processes that scale — this is your role.

Key job responsibilities
Ingest customer contracts accurately and on time — acknowledge tickets within 1 business day, resolve standard issues within 5 days per SOP, and execute with ≥98.6% accuracy
Own end-to-end ingestion of complex contract structures, including multi-service and percentage-based constructs
Analyze ingestion failures and propose systemic fixes rather than one-off workarounds
Design solutions for new and non-standard contract structures, applying judgment where SOPs don't yet exist
Experiment with AI and automation to improve ingestion accuracy and reduce billing errors
Lead ingestion-related discussions in weekly business reviews with leadership
Partner cross-functionally with engineering and design teams to translate ingestion needs into system requirements
Identify opportunities to reduce manual touches and design scalable ingestion processes for new use cases
Document ingestion issues, procedures, and new contractual terms thoroughly for team reference

A day in the life
You'll start by reviewing your ingestion queue — prioritizing tickets and working complex contract structures that don't fit a standard template. When something fails, you dig into the root cause and propose a systemic fix rather than a patch. You'll partner with your team and engineering on system requirements, lead the ingestion portion of an WBR, and test whether AI can catch errors earlier in the process. Throughout, you document what you learn and look for ways to take manual touches out of tomorrow's workflow.

About the team
The AWS Billing Contract Onboarding team makes sure every customer contract is ingested into our billing systems accurately and on time — the foundation of a correct first bill. We're a collaborative, customer-obsessed group that partners closely with engineering, design, and finance to solve hard problems at scale. We believe in operational excellence, continuous improvement, and using AI and automation to work smarter. You'll join a team that values deep expertise, clear communication, and helping each other grow.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You will collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services seeks a senior leader to manage a team of Technical Infrastructure Program Managers (TIPMs) to support data center infrastructure expansion. This leader, through their team, will lead cross functional teams to deliver Data Center build projects, from inception through design, implementation, testing, and deployment across Japan and Korea.

This leader drives the development and adoption of strategies in the region, initiates programs that address regional and global challenges and programs, coordinates and drives execution with local partner teams, removes obstacles during implementation, and reports progress and risks on all in-flight programs. This leader should be able to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders. They are expected to become a voice of the region to influence new global initiatives and programs that will inform the next generation of Data Centers. This leader drives improvements in overall program execution, streamlines processes, and enhances efficiency. Successful candidates likely have background in a technical discipline (construction, engineering, or other sciences), have experience in project and program management of complex initiatives, are able to build trust and relationships with various stakeholders, and have strong problem solving skills. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. Successful candidates are likely to be passionate, embrace constructive conflict, manage ambiguity well, and are eager to solve complex problems.

Candidates must be comfortable managing a team reporting to them located both locally and remotely. You will also interact and engage with matrixed project delivery teams across the globe. Successful candidates possess the ability to work with matrixed teams to troubleshoot project technical implementation issues and remove barriers to project success. Being able to lead cross-functional teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery is a must.

Successful candidates are familiar with project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of a project's lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated proficiency in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking.

This position requires 10% domestic travel (trips to local AWS Data Center Clusters) and 5% international travel.


Key job responsibilities
• Leading, hiring, and developing a team of Technical Infrastructure Program Managers (TIPMs).
• Demonstrating tactical and strategic thinking and applying high judgement to ensure data center delivery for customers.
• Developing and reviewing metrics and assessing performance against targets to identify improvements to delivery timelines and opportunities to close gaps.
• Monitoring in-flight projects, major risks, and improvement efforts. Ensuring delivery is on track to meet supply commitments and constantly changing customer demand
• Diving deep into capacity issues to identify risks and opportunities, and resolving constraints by negotiating across multiple stakeholders.
• Identifying opportunities to invent and simplify processes, identifying business risks, and implementing scalable mechanisms.

A day in the life
In this role, you will drive data center delivery programs in the Japan and Korea regions by collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. You will lead stakeholder meetings to align partner teams, share progress, and escalate quickly to deliver business outcomes. You will identify opportunities to invent and simplify process, develop seamless project execution and remove unnecessary or redundant process. You will communicate clearly, and proactively to remove roadblocks, pave the way for innovation, and can handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Regular/ad-hoc communications and reporting to executive leadership, peer groups, and stakeholders.

As part of the AWS Infrastructure organization, the Data Center Planning and Delivery team prepares for, plans, and builds the data centers that comprise the AWS cloud. This team drives continuous improvement of AWS Data Centers to provide more efficient and reliable infrastructure to customers.

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Amazon Fire TV
descriptionHtml:
Why This Role Matters

The way customers watch television is changing. Alongside broadcast TV, the growth of streaming content has diversified what customers want from a TV. Fire TV is expanding beyond streaming devices into the television itself. In this role, you'll plan and execute the marketing strategy in Japan for the growing Fire TV built-in smart TV business. You'll drive the business end-to-end — from product launch through post-launch growth — taking comprehensive ownership across business planning, sales promotion to hit targets, and the design and execution of marketing initiatives on both online and offline channels.

Who You Are

You're an experienced professional who has independently led marketing and sales-promotion programs and delivered results - ideally at a consumer-electronics manufacturer, a global tech company, or a similarly fast-moving business. You can build marketing plans together with partner companies - TV manufacturers, consumer-electronics retailers, and others - and communicate the value Fire TV brings to customers. You commit to results, and you can design and execute the promotions and channel marketing that grow the numbers. Working with senior management and global teams, you bring cross-functional stakeholders along, make sound judgment calls even when the situation is ambiguous, and move fast when the opportunity demands it. This role drives strategy locally while partnering with global teams. Native-level Japanese and business-level English are both required.

このポジションの魅力

お客様のテレビの楽しみ方は変わりつつあります。テレビ放送に加え、ネット動画コンテンツが増え、お客様のニーズも多様化しています。Fire TVは、ストリーミングデバイスの枠を超え、テレビそのものへと広がっています。このポジションでは、成長を続けるFire TV搭載スマートテレビ事業における、日本のマーケティング戦略を立案・実行します。商品の立ち上げからローンチ後のビジネス推進までを一気通貫でドライブし、事業計画の策定、予算達成に向けた販売促進、オンライン・オフラインでの各種マーケティング施策の企画・実行まで、包括的な責任をもって事業を推進します。

求める人物像

家電メーカー、グローバルテックなど、変化の速い業界で、マーケティングおよび販売促進のプログラムを自ら主導し、成果を出してきた経験豊富な方を求めています。テレビメーカー、家電量販店などのパートナー企業と共にマーケティングプランを描き、Fire TVがもたらす価値をお客様に伝えていける方。結果にコミットし、数字を伸ばすプロモーションやチャネルマーケティングを企画・実行していける方。シニアマネジメント、グローバルチームと連携し、部門を超えたステークホルダーを巻き込み、曖昧な状況でも的確な判断を下し、機会が求めるときには素早く動ける方。日本市場の戦略をローカルで推進しつつ、グローバルチームと連携するポジションです。日本語（ネイティブレベル）と英語（ビジネスレベル）の両方が必要です。

Key job responsibilities
1. Partner Brand Marketing Strategy & Execution: Lead the go-to-market and marketing strategy for the Fire TV built-in smart TV business in Japan. Develop marketing plans with TV-brand partners and drive integrated initiatives across online and offline channels. Review and approve customer-facing assets to ensure consistent messaging and branding.

title: System Architecture Lead, Direct-to-Device, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is building a Low Earth Orbit satellite constellation designed to provide connectivity to customers around the world.

We are looking for an experienced system architecture lead with end-to-end experience across the direct-to-device (D2D) satellite and cellular ecosystem. This role owns the end-to-end technical architecture of the D2D service, translating customer and business needs into a coherent system solution across core, RAN, satellite, devices, spectrum, regulatory, and service.

The ideal candidate has already architected real D2D, NTN, satellite-to-cellular, or closely related systems and understands how architecture decisions in one domain affect the others. This is not a role focused on a single engineering discipline. We are looking for someone who can define the complete system, drive cross-domain decisions and trade-offs, and keep the solution technically coherent as requirements, customer needs, and subsystem designs evolve.

The successful candidate will combine broad cellular and service knowledge with strong customer and partner skills, strong ownership, and the ability to lead in a fast-moving, international environment.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end D2D technical architecture and the technical plan of record.
• Translate customer, MNO, and business needs into the system architecture, working closely with Business, Product, and Solutions Architecture.
• Drive cross-domain architecture decisions and trade-offs across core, RAN, satellite payload, devices, spectrum, regulatory, and service, and document their rationale.
• Assess technical feasibility of proposed solutions and support customer and MNO engagements, so that commitments are clear, achievable, and aligned with system capabilities.
• Partner with Systems Engineering to turn the architecture into requirements, interfaces, and acceptance criteria that Development can build and test against.
• Maintain end-to-end technical coherence as requirements, customer needs, and subsystem designs evolve, and resolve cross-domain conflicts between development teams.
• Bring ecosystem requirements and findings (MNO, OEM, chipset) back into the architecture, working with Telco Service Development.
• Define the evolution path of the architecture, including new features, markets, device categories, and next-generation satellites.
• Act as the subject matter expert for the end-to-end D2D architecture, and represent the architecture with leadership, customers, partners, and vendors.
• Work effectively across geographically distributed, international and multicultural engineering, business, and customer organizations.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a related field
- 8+ years of relevant professional experience in satellite or cellular systems, including at least 3 years architecting Direct-to-Device (D2D), NTN, or direct satellite-to-cellular systems.
- Demonstrated end-to-end knowledge of D2D architectures, including satellite payload and ground segment, RAN, 5G core, and commercial devices.
- Experience making and documenting cross-domain architecture decisions and trade-offs in complex systems involving multiple engineering teams.
- Working knowledge of 3GPP NTN standards, mobility, and interworking with terrestrial networks
- Experience working directly with mobile network operators, device OEMs, or chipset vendors on D2D solutions.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with satellite-based RAN architectures for NTN.
- Experience with voice over NR (VoNR/IMS), messaging, and emergency services.
- Experience with device interoperability testing and certification programs.
- Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively across engineering teams, vendors, partners, and leadership organizations.
- Experience with spectrum and regulatory aspects of satellite services (spectrum, PFD and emission limits, licensing).
- Experience with system budgets and analysis (link, power, capacity, availability) for satellite systems.
- Experience translating business and commercial models into technical architecture.
- Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively across engineering teams, business, customers, partners, and leadership organizations.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Legal Technology
descriptionHtml:
You will be the product manager for Contract Central, Amazon Legal's contract lifecycle management platform. It holds about 3.5 million contracts, about 20,000 to 25,000 more are signed through it each month, and it has nearly 60,000 users. Hundreds of internal teams connect to it through APIs.

Most business users open it only a few times a year, so it has to make sense without training or a call to Legal. The team also leads a 2026 S-Team goal and works closely with the Amazon Quick organization on bringing AI into contracting.

Where the platform goes next is not fully defined. You will set the goals and lead the work, asking for direction when you need it. You should be comfortable with SQL, with how APIs work, and with detailed technical conversations with engineers.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Contract Central. Decide what to build and what to leave out, often with incomplete data, and explain your choices in writing to senior managers and Directors, and to VPs when needed.
- Watch business users, lawyers and admins use the product, and separate problems many of them share from one-off requests.
- Work with design and engineering to take steps out of intake, approvals, signing and workflow setup, and decide where AI and automation should do the work, such as prefilling forms or routing contracts for signature.
- Evaluate technical proposals by asking what each design makes harder to change later, and balance new features with the health of a platform that hundreds of internal teams build on.
- Own launches and their results. Define metrics that separate adoption from outcomes such as satisfaction, cycle time and contracts completed without Legal, and pull the data yourself.
- Align lawyers, legal operations, tax, procurement and business teams with different priorities, and mentor and help hire other product managers.


A day in the life
It is release day for Contract Central. You send the release note and hold office hours. Then you sit with an admin setting up a new contract workflow and note each decision that slows them down. After lunch you write the SQL for the monthly business review yourself, because every number needs a denominator and a trend. The Amazon Quick team asks for an API change, and you work out with an engineer whether it is worth doing now. You end the day in a recorded session with a business user who uses the platform a few times a year.

About the team
We are the Legal Technology team in Amazon Legal. We build the software Amazon's lawyers and business teams use to create, approve, sign and manage contracts. The team is small for what it owns, so the role is broad. You will work with a dedicated engineering team, design, business intelligence and legal leads, and you will write your own queries, release notes and user surveys. Over the next year we are focused on recovering user satisfaction, making contracting easier for occasional users and admins, and keeping Contract Central reliable as more teams and AI tools build on it.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Knowledge of key customer experience metrics and methodology (e.g., NPS)
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning technology products

title: Technik údržby, RME
descriptionHtml:
Tým odborné údržby (Reliability Maintenance Engineering – RME) ve společnosti Amazon má zásadní význam pro náš provoz – jsou to právě jeho pracovníci, kdo udržují životně důležité stroje v neustálém chodu. Jako technik/technička RME budete provádět údržbu široké škály zařízení a pracovišť a zároveň dodržovat osvědčené postupy v oblasti bezpečnosti a ochrany zdraví. Budete pomáhat zajišťovat bezpečnost svých kolegů a předcházet odstávkám strojů. Naši technici RME zvyšují kvalitu našich zařízení a současně pracují i na zlepšování provozního prostředí.



Key job responsibilities
Klíčové pracovní povinnosti:

- Proaktivní a preventivní údržba široké škály zařízení na pracovišti.
- Za provozu provádět diagnostiku závad v distribučním skladu a návazné opravy.
- Používat nejnovější nástroje k maximalizaci efektivity zařízení.
- Dodržovat všechny zásady a postupy v oblasti bezpečnosti a ochrany zdraví při práci.

- Pracovat na projektech neustálého zlepšování a zavádět osvědčené postupy na řadě pracovišť v rámci EU.

A day in the life
Náplň pracovního dne:

Naši technici RME působí přímo na provozních pracovištích, takže mohou rychle reagovat na případné problémy se stroji. Budete provádět řadu plánovaných preventivních údržbových prací na zařízeních v našich provozech s cílem zajistit jejich bezpečné fungování. Jako technik/technička RME budete také pohotově reagovat na havárie, co nejrychleji zjišťovat jejich příčiny a zároveň hledat a realizovat řešení. Budete také předkládat návrhy na dlouhodobá zlepšení.
Po boku zkušenějších kolegů budete provádět každodenní údržbářské činnosti, jako jsou lakýrnické a instalatérské práce, a bude-li třeba externí odborné pomoci, budete spolupracovat s dodavateli. Budete pracovat v různých směnách, abyste zajistili nepřetržitou podporu našich pracovišť – což společnosti Amazon umožňuje poskytovat služby rychlostí, kterou vyniká.

descriptionHtml:

As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.

The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best-in-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.




A day in the life
Embark on a week filled with meaningful contributions to the operation and improvement of significant software systems. You dedicate a substantial portion of your time to carefully review the operational health of services within your team's responsibility. In the process, you diligently identify anomalies and craft actionable bug reports, aspiring to enhance the overall efficiency and performance of your systems.

title: Software Development Engineer II, EC2 Blackfoot Peering Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) Networking is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to help build forwarding and encapsulation services that power large-scale networking within AWS. Your work will directly impact millions of customers who rely on EC2 every day.

We are growing fast and looking for kernel and embedded C programmers who can deliver ultra-high performance. Our goal is to process many millions of packets per second on embedded CPU cores. This requires implementing highly optimized data structures and low-level tuning to our hardware. If you have strong experience in C or C++ and a passion for systems software engineering such as kernel or embedded development, this is a unique opportunity to join us in building the platform that will underpin all new EC2 Virtual Private Cloud features in the years to come.

Dataplane engineers work on a lower level of the software stack that directly interacts with hardware. They require knowledge of programming languages optimized for lower-level work such as C, C++, Rust, and Assembly Language, along with the ability to read a hardware specification for a network card and optimize code to run on it.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement high-performance forwarding and encapsulation services in C and C++, optimizing data structures and tuning code for embedded CPU cores processing millions of packets per second.
- Collaborate with hardware and software engineers across EC2 Networking to translate hardware specifications into performant dataplane code, ensuring scalability and reliability for AWS customers.
- Participate in architecture decisions, design reviews, and code reviews, providing meaningful feedback to teammates and mentoring junior engineers on best practices for low-level systems development.
Own features across the full development lifecycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations — while identifying root causes of operational issues and driving permanent fixes.

descriptionHtml:
The AWS Data Center Availability Serviceability team works with hundreds of AWS data centers globally to deliver the highest quality and lowest cost availability, capacity, and scaling results for our customers. We standardize operations globally by delivering tools, policy, processes, and procedures to our internal teams.

Serviceability is the ability to maintain, repair, and manage infrastructure assets efficiently throughout their lifecycle -- encompassing maintenance standards, spares management, training and certifications, operational readiness, and the systematic use of data and automation to prevent disruptions and drive continuous improvement.

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to support serviceability for liquid cooling infrastructure in AWS data centers. Liquid cooling is a new and fast-growing technology that supports the next generation of high-density compute, including AI and machine learning workloads. This role will define how liquid-cooled equipment is maintained, serviced and kept ready to operate as we scale from early deployments to a global fleet.
What you will do:

You will support the serviceability program for liquid cooling across the AWS fleet. You will write and maintain preventive maintenance (PM) guidelines for liquid cooling components, such as coolant distribution, heat exchange and fluid management systems. You will build these guidelines with Operations, Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) and equipment vendors. You will partner with Finance on labor analyses that turn maintenance needs into staffing plans. You will work with Field Engineering to lead root cause analyses on maintenance and equipment findings, and you will make sure the lessons feed back into PM standards and procedures. You will work with Operations and site teams to build operational readiness plans for new liquid-cooled sites, then track readiness so every site is ready to operate safely and reliably from day one. You will also run field trials and stakeholder workshops to check procedures, collect feedback and drive continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities
Own the execution and success metrics for liquid cooling serviceability across the global fleet
Write and maintain PM guidelines for liquid cooling components, working with Operations, DCEO and vendors
Conduct labor analyses with Finance to support annual and long-range staffing plans
Lead root cause analyses with Field Engineering on maintenance and equipment findings, and drive corrective actions into standards
Build operational readiness plans with Operations and site teams, and track readiness as new sites deploy
Run field trials and stakeholder workshops to validate procedures and collect operational feedback
Build mechanisms that keep serviceability standards current as the fleet grows and new equipment and vendors are introduced
Use data and metrics to measure program health, prioritize effort and report progress
Write narratives (one to six pages) and present to Director-level leadership
Travel up to 10–15%

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing serviceability/maintenance programs

本ポジションは、eero日本市場における「立ち上げメンバー」です。日本初のPartner Success採用として、パートナーエンゲージメントモデルをゼロから構築する責任を担います。日本の主要ISPパートナーとのリレーションシップを主導し、Go-to-Market戦略を策定し、eeroのグローバルプロダクト・エンジニアリングチームと日本パートナーを繋ぐ架け橋となります。

This is a founding role. You will be the first eero Partner Success hire in Japan, responsible for implementing our partner engagement model from the ground up. You'll own relationships with Japan's major ISP partners, shape go-to-market strategy, and serve as the bridge between eero's global product and engineering teams and our Japan partners.

eeroのBusiness Development、Product、Engineering、Manufacturing Operations、Finance、Legal、Supportの各チームと密接に連携します。レポートラインはオーストラリア拠点のPartner Successチームリードであり、米国およびAPAC各タイムゾーンとの定常的なコラボレーションがあります。
You'll work closely with eero's Business Development, Product, Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Finance, Legal, and Support teams. This role reports to the Partner Success team lead based in Australia, with regular collaboration across US and APAC time zones.

• -戦略的パートナーリレーションシップの主導— 日本のISPパートナーに対する第一の窓口として、パートナーの事業目標を深く理解し、ニーズを先読みし、課題を先回りして解決します。Own strategic partner relationships — Serve as the primary point of contact for Japan ISP partners. Acquire deep knowledge of their business objectives, anticipate needs, and resolve issues proactively.
• デプロイメント推進・収益拡大— パートナーのローンチを加速し、拡大機会を特定し、パートナーとeero双方の収益最大化施策を実行します。Drive deployments & revenue — Accelerate partner launches, identify expansion opportunities, and execute on revenue-maximizing initiatives for both partners and eero.

• 戦略的アドバイザリー — パートナーの信頼を獲得し、テクノロジー戦略に影響を与えます。Product、Engineering、Legal、Financeと協業し、共同ロードマップを策定します。Strategic advisory — Earn partners' trust and influence their technology strategy. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Finance to develop joint roadmaps.
• 測定・レポーティング — レポーティングフレームワークを構築し、パートナーKPIを追跡し、データに基づいた意思決定と機会創出を推進しますMeasure & report — Build reporting frameworks, track partner KPIs, and use data to identify opportunities and drive decisions.

title: Sr. Mgr - EF, AB, Analytics, IN External Fulfilment, Amazon Business, 3P Carriers and NOW Procurement
descriptionHtml:
External Fulfilment runs the third-party fulfilment channels that let sellers and vendors ship directly from their own warehouses while giving customers an FBA-grade experience. The channel portfolio spans Seller Flex (SF), Vendor Flex (VF), Direct Fulfilment (DF), Warehouse Integration (WI), Stores Integration (SI) and Easy Ship. These channels carry a large share of unique selection, free up FC capacity for fast-moving selection, and operate at a lower cost to serve than in-FC fulfilment.

We are looking for a senior leader to own the fulfilment channel programs for SF, DF and WI, run flow control for the entire EF network, lead fulfilment operations for Amazon Business, and build the analytical backbone that supports all of the above. This is a broad, ambiguous, network-level mandate that sits at the intersection of operations, program management, product and finance. The role requires an owner who can set strategy, drive execution across cross-functional partners, and hold the bar on performance.

Key job responsibilities
1. Fulfilment channel programs: Own the end-to-end program charter for the Seller Flex, Direct Fulfilment and Warehouse Integration channels. This covers channel program and product strategy, network configuration and policy management. You will drive seller-experience initiatives across these channels and partner with 3P Business, product and tech teams on roadmap and launches.

2. Flow control for EF network: Own flow control across the entire EF network - managing the flow of packages through the transportation network, deploying seller caps and TCAP management to safeguard transportation capacity against surges and over-attainment, and collaborating with supply chain to minimise speed losses.

3. Amazon Business (B2B) fulfilment operations: Own the operations program for Amazon Business in India - the B2B delivery experience, cost, over-all DEX metrics and related programs. This workstream requires cross-org dependencies and leadership visibility involved, and partnership with the category and WW AB teams.

4. GenAI, Analytics and reporting: Build and own the GenAI charter for the entire team, analytical foundation for the above - WBR/MBR dashboards, P0 metric tracking, carrier-level breakdowns and program trackers. You will raise the robustness of analysis and move it beyond daily ops and coordination into decision-grade insight.

About the team
Your day starts with the health of the network - reading overnight P0 metrics and deciding where to act. Then you would prioritise SF, DF and WI program and product with 3P Business, product and tech partners. Then Amazon Business - DEX metrics, the AWIPL network and its escalations. Analytics runs through all of it: you build the data and bring decision-grade insight to weekly and monthly reviews. You partner across 3P Business, Finance, Tech/Product and the last-mile, middle-mile and sort-centre teams, serving customers, sellers and enterprise buyers alike.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of team management experience
- 7+ years of program or project management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- MBA
- 8+ years of team management experience
- Experience in logistics, or experience in e-commerce, retail or advertising
- Experience in transportation or supply chain within a high-volume logistics, manufacturing or engineering environment
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organization
- Exposure to B2B / enterprise fulfilment and delivery-experience metrics.

title: Transportation Program Manager, ROC Quality Management
descriptionHtml:
■ポジション概要
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) 部門では、年間数億にのぼる商品をお客様とお約束したお届け日に安全かつ正確にお届けすべく、日本全国のAmazon物流拠点を結ぶ大規模な幹線輸送ネットワークを構築・運営しています。1日5,000運行を超えるこの複雑なネットワーク運営の中核を担うRelay Operation Center (ROC) において、幹線輸送における品質を管理するQuality Management (QM) チームのメンバーを募集します。
ROC QMチームは以下の3つの機能を有し、それぞれの品質水準を高めることで、お客様に最上のサービスを提供します。

(1) 幹線輸送（出荷拠点から配達拠点まで）における輸送期日遵守率の品質管理・改善
期日順守率全体の数値管理を行います。また輸送キャパシティや拠点での処理能力を超過することで発生する貨物の滞留への初動対応、および中期的な対応精度の向上と最適化に取り組みます。

(2) ネットワーク拡大や時季的要因で変動する遅延リスクに対する幹線トラック定刻運行の品質管理・改善
トラックの運行は、大型連休や物流の繁閑期、気象条件、交通事故など、様々な要因の影響を受けます。このような環境下において、社内外のステークホルダーと連携し、輸送品質の安定的な維持・向上を実現します。

(3) 天候災害発生時（台風・大雪など）の品質維持と早期回復に向けたプロセス管理
自然災害が配送網に与える影響を予測・分析し、お客様へのお届け予定日時の調整や配送網の復旧オペレーションを指揮します。また、災害対応プロセスの構築や改善を通じて、安定した配送サービスを実現します。

■本ポジションの魅力
業界経験を問わず、課題解決や業務プロセス改善に意欲的に取り組めるメンバーが活躍できる環境があり、以下のような魅力があります。
- インパクトの大きさ：ROCは日本におけるAmazonの輸送ネットワークの中核を担う組織です。全国のネットワークに影響を及ぼす意思決定に携わり、出荷拠点や配達拠点の担当者、運送会社とも連携した大規模なアクションをリードすることができます。
- キャリア成長機会：オペレーション構築、データ分析、プロセス設計など、幅広いスキルを習得できます。将来的にはチームマネジメントの経験も積むことが可能です。また、物流において特定領域に限定されず、セントラルオペレーション、倉庫業務、プランニングなど、総合的な知見を習得できます。
- グローバル対応力：EUや北米で実践されているベストプラクティスの導入に関わることができます。また、希望に応じて海外のテクノロジーを日本のオペレーションに最適化して導入するプロジェクトにも参画できます。

Amazonの輸送オペレーションの仕組みづくりに携わりながら、様々なスキルを磨くことができます。あなたの経験と可能性を活かし、世界最高品質のECサービスの実現に共に取り組みませんか。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
- チームのイニシアティブを理解して、担当する業務領域におけるプロジェクトを推進する。
- 管理指標やデータを分析することで現状の課題を見出し、解消のためのアクションやKPIを策定・実行する。
- 業務プロセス上の異常を検知し、要因分析と改善に向けた対応を実施する。

A day in the life
[50%] 品質指標の改善に向けたデータ分析、ステークホルダーとの調整を含むプロジェクト推進
[30%] チームが管理する業務プロセス改善、イレギュラー対応

title: Sr Design Operations, Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching? Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies and TV. From one service, we're delivering versatile ways to watch hundreds of thousands of movies, TV series, and live events on the web, mobile, and TV. Our service is available in 240+ territories globally, and we're just getting started.

The Amazon Prime Video UX team is seeking a self-motivated, ownership-minded, and nimble Senior Design Operations partner to be a force-multiplier for our UX Design & Research team, amplifying our efforts and impact. We design innovative experiences allowing customers around the world to discover, purchase, and watch the latest digital video content live and on demand.

You will collaborate closely with designers, researchers, engineers, product managers, and program managers leading projects throughout the planning, design, and development cycle. Your emphasis will be on planning and prioritization of design deliverables, resource management, schedule tracking, mitigating project risks, and collaborating with design leadership to deliver innovative solutions across workstreams. You will be a key part of a UX Design and Research team collaborating across all aspects of the Prime Video service. Come build the future of entertainment with us!

Key job responsibilities
- Own the operational strategy for complex, ambiguous design programs end to end, where the strategy and often the operating model are not yet defined and there is no precedent to copy
- Partner with UX leadership on key decisions and own the design roadmap for the organization: requirements gathering, scheduling, prioritization, capacity and resource planning, contracting and budget, and coordination of teams and reviews
- Own programs and portfolios of programs from concept to delivery, including the design decisions and escalations along the way
- Define the operational tool and AI strategy for the organization: govern adoption, set responsible-use guidelines, and decide where AI-augmented workflows are appropriate and where the work stays human-led
- Build automated workflows that scale design and research operations, and evaluate emerging tools against clear criteria and measurable outcomes
- Lead design delivery by managing team backlogs and removing obstacles, coordinating reviews with stakeholders and leadership, and empowering designers to own their timelines
- Design change strategies for org-wide operational shifts: build coalition before rollout, measure adoption, iterate, and balance the pace of change against the team's capacity
- Standardize, socialize, and continuously improve our user-centered design process, and build the operational infrastructure behind it, including research repositories, tooling, and how insights reach the people who need them
- Act as a bridge between UX, Engineering, Product Management, and other cross-functional partners, making sure interdependencies are understood and planned for, and influencing priorities without direct authority
- Anticipate bottlenecks, manage escalations, and balance customer needs against business goals and technical constraints, mitigating long-term risk and not only the immediate kind
- Define success metrics and own their implementation across our work, and craft the strategic narratives that connect it to business outcomes for senior leaders in yearly planning and business reviews
- Enable creative solutions through design acumen and high judgment, distinguishing one-way doors from two-way doors
- Promote transparency, visibility, and community across the team

About the team
Prime Video's vision is to be the world's most loved premium video service, and in doing so to become the default entertainment hub, globally for customers.
