title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

This role will be physically based at our new MDD Pecos, TX site.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

-2+ years of relevant work experience
-Experience in relevant work
-Can bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
-Can use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
-Can walk on job sites in uneven terrain
-Can work at heights and from ladders

Preferred qualifications

-4+ years of data center engineering experience
-Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
-Knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling
-Experience in data center engineering
-Can perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired

title: Finance Manager - Enterprise Risk Management, North America Trans Buildings
descriptionHtml:
Ever wonder how your Amazon packages get to your doorstep? Now you can learn by being part of the Finance team supporting these operations.

North America Trans Buildings, comprised of six networks, is looking for a Finance Manager to help with the controllership of our multibillion-dollar assets. North America Customer Fulfillment (NACF) is Amazon's large-scale fulfillment network dedicated to getting customer orders picked, packed, and delivered. Every day several million packages from multiple fulfillment centers across the US and Canada arrive in one of the ~100 sort centers where they are sorted for delivery, which improves truck utilization and reduces transportation costs. title: Embedded Software Engineer II, Ring
descriptionHtml:
Ring is growing in Poland and we are looking for experienced Embedded Software Engineers to join our team in Gdansk. You will work on firmware for IoT devices used by millions of customers worldwide, developing new features and shipping products from concept to production.

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will own the design and implementation of firmware subsystems running on resource-constrained hardware. You will work across the full development cycle: architecture, implementation, code review, testing on real devices, and production release. Our team operates with high autonomy and a strong feedback culture.

The ideal candidate:

- Has shipped embedded products to production and understands what it takes to go from prototype to millions of devices in the field.
- Writes clean, maintainable C/C++ for constrained environments and cares deeply about code quality.
- Communicates proactively, raises technical risks early, and drives solutions across teams.
- Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift as customer needs evolve.
- Is curious about the full stack, from hardware registers to cloud connectivity, and enjoys learning new domains.


Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware in C/C++ for Ring devices.
- Specify and implement functionality for embedded subsystems (connectivity, streaming, power management, sensors, or security).
- Collaborate with hardware, QA, cloud, and app teams to deliver integrated product experiences.
- Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and cross-team architecture decisions.
- Debug complex issues across hardware and software boundaries using JTAG, UART, and protocol analyzers.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing a code change from a colleague working on a new sensor driver. After your team standup, you spend focused time implementing a feature for an upcoming product launch, testing it on real hardware at your desk. In the afternoon, you dig into a tricky issue that only reproduces on one board variant, tracing it from application code down to a register misconfiguration. You push your fix, verify it on the device, and close the day knowing it will ship to customers in the next release.

Basic qualifications

- BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Extensive embedded development experience in C or C++
- Familiarity and experience with ARM CPUs
- Experience with writing low-level drivers, interrupt service routines and general troubleshooting/debugging with hardware

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field
- Experience with one of more commercial wireless protocols like BLE or WiFi
- Experience in firmware development and testing of battery powered products
- Experience with development tools like IAR/Keil and Git version control system
- Experience with common bus protocols such as SPI, I2C, and UART
- Experience with software testing (unit, regression and system testing)
- Knowledge of embedded Linux and FreeRTOS
- Comfortable in some scripting language such as Python
- Experience in building GenAI applications

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager - Logistics, Global Corporate Procurement
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to pioneer and globalize new businesses and customer offerings daily. As we rapidly become the world's largest consumer of corporate services in many categories, the Corporate Strategic Procurement team is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Manager to join our team. This role is uniquely positioned at the nexus of business units across Amazon, and offers singular vision into a broad spectrum of cross-company initiatives and strategies on a global scale. Using this unique insight, the Strategic Sourcing Manager will build and lead sourcing engagements for both existing and newly emerging categories of spend, as well as negotiate multi-faceted partnership agreements for Amazon's high-growth businesses worldwide. Strategic Sourcing Managers own complex categories across multiple business units and regions, often in markets with limited competition and pricing transparency, and lead transformational sourcing initiatives with global scope. Strategic Sourcing Managers are expert practitioners in creating competitive environments, and have a strong bias for decision making rooted in data and analytics. They routinely influence C-level vendor relationships by advising senior Amazon leaders across multiple stakeholder groups on the direction of sourcing projects in support of business unit and corporate goals, and they raise the bar for sourcing peers across the global team. Successful candidates must work well in a fast-paced and often ambiguous arena, and will be rewarded by working alongside highly collaborative and entrepreneurial colleagues in an environment that feels much more "startup" than "big company". This role supports the Logistics spend category and we are seeking experienced sourcing professional with experience in this arena who have a passion for serving customers and for driving change and impact on a global scale, then we would love to talk with you.

Key job responsibilities
- Owning one or more complex (sub-)categories across multiple business units and/or regions, developing and executing (sub-)category strategies
- Developing global sourcing strategies to deliver against business objectives for internal clients, and achieving sustainable relationships with suppliers.
- Managing categories in markets with limited competition and limited pricing transparency, proactively identifying and mitigating supplier, commercial, and ESG risk.
- Evaluating supplier core competencies and competitive positioning using industry cost models and bench-marking analysis.
- Managing the fundamentals of sourcing and supplier engagement activities, including RFx, spend pattern analysis, contract analysis, bid evaluation, negotiations, and supplier consolidation.
- Leading transformational sourcing projects with complex, global scope, coordinating work across team members and regions.
- Working with business and finance leaders to identify and drive savings and controllership improvements, focusing on total cost of ownership, and value creation beyond cost savings.
- Presenting sourcing strategies, recommendations, and decisions to senior leaders up to three levels above you.
- Contributing inputs to annual and long-range operating plans (OP1, OP2, and three-year forecast).
- Providing guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement processes and maintaining procurement ethics in accordance with Amazon's global policies.
- Preparing and holding business reviews with stakeholders to review vendor performance, future opportunities, and/or challenges.
- Mentoring and sharing best practices with sourcing peers across the global team.


A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cross-functional alignment call for an upcoming RFP involving three business units, followed by analyzing bid responses and building a recommendation deck for senior leadership. After lunch, you're on a negotiation call with a strategic supplier's C-suite to finalize contract terms, then pivoting to a spend review with Finance to validate savings actuals against targets. You'll close the day by coaching a business partner through the supplier evaluation framework for an upcoming engagement. No two days look the same — you'll balance long-range strategic planning with hands-on execution, often managing five or more active sourcing engagements simultaneously across different stages of the lifecycle.


About the team
Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) manages Amazon's indirect spend across Employee Services, Marketing, Professional Services, Technology, Logistics, and Real Estate & Facilities. We're a global team of sourcing professionals who combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to deliver sustainable value at scale. Our culture values deep ownership, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action — we move fast, but we move smart. You'll be joining a team where your work is visible to senior leadership and directly tied to Amazon's bottom line.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, etc.)
- 5+ years of experience managing indirect spend categories that include Logistics, Transportation, and Energy Infrastructure

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 5+ years of relevant strategic sourcing and category management in categories such as professional services, operations, maintenance & repair, heavy duty asset, transportation based new product development.
- Experience in a non-mandated, indirect procurement function at a multinational corporation
- Experience owning complex sourcing categories across multiple business units and/or regions
- Experience managing categories in markets with limited competition or limited pricing transparency, including proactive supplier risk management
- Experience leading transformational or cross-regional sourcing initiatives with global scope
- Experience advising and presenting sourcing strategy to senior executives and influencing C-level vendor relationships
- Experience contributing to annual or long-range operating plans
- Experience mentoring peers or coordinating sourcing work across a distributed team

title: Sr. Manager, Foundation IP (Standard Cells & Memories),, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, our silicon organization within AWS Utility Computing, builds the custom chips behind AWS — Graviton, Nitro, Inferentia and Trainium. Our Machine Learning Acceleration (MLA) team develops the Trainium and Inferentia SoCs that train and serve frontier AI models at datacenter scale.

On AI silicon, foundation IP is not a commodity. SRAM and register files dominate die area and power, and every picosecond and square micron in a standard cell library compounds across billions of instances. We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Foundation IP to own that layer end to end — from foundry DTCO and vendor roadmaps, through custom cell and memory definition, to characterization and silicon correlation on leading-edge GAA nodes (N3, N2 and below).

You will be the single technical point of contact for our foundation IP vendors and memory providers, lead a hands-on team of 3–6 engineers, and partner with Architecture, Physical Design, CAD, DFT and Product Engineering to turn IP decisions into measurable PPA wins on every Trainium and Inferentia generation. This is a player-coach role: you will set strategy and hold vendors to Amazon’s bar — and you will also review schematics, layouts and Liberty data yourself.


Key job responsibilities
• Foundation IP strategy & vendor ownership
– Own the foundation IP roadmap — standard cell libraries, memory compilers, custom macros, GPIO/ESD, eFuse/OTP and PVT sensors — aligned to multi-generation Trainium and Inferentia product plans.
– Serve as the primary technical interface to foundation IP vendors and the foundry: define deliverable specifications, negotiate SOWs and schedules, and drive ECOs, version control and release cadence.
– Influence vendor roadmaps to secure features and PPA that differentiate AWS silicon; resolve quality escapes with data, not escalation alone.
– Build IP intake and QA mechanisms — checklists, regressions and acceptance criteria for every library, memory and view drop.

• PPA evaluation & library selection
– Lead quantitative evaluation of competing libraries, memory compilers and cell architectures using block-level synthesis and place-and-route benchmarks (Synopsys Fusion Compiler, Cadence Innovus) on representative ML datapath, SRAM-heavy and high-utilization blocks.
– Drive cell-architecture decisions — cell height, mixed-height (short/tall) libraries, VT and channel-length flavors, nanosheet width options, backside power delivery — with clear PPA, cost and schedule tradeoffs.
– Partner with Physical Design and CAD to deploy selected IP into the RTL-to-GDSII flow and close the loop on post-implementation PPA.

• Memory specification & vendor interface
– Define memory requirements for ML accelerator workloads — single/dual-port SRAM, multi-port register files, ROM, TCAM/CAM — including capacity, banking, bandwidth, latency, Vmin and leakage targets.
– Specify bitcell selection (high-density vs. high-current), read/write assist, redundancy and repair, MBIST/BISR interfaces, power-gating, retention and sleep modes.
– Own the memory vendor relationship, compiler release qualification, and integration support for Physical Design and DFT teams.

• Latch arrays & custom memory macros
– Lead design and integration of latch-based arrays and custom register files for small, high-bandwidth buffers where compiler SRAM or flop arrays fall short on PPA.
– Define the selection methodology across compiler SRAM, custom macros, latch arrays and flop-based storage; own the timing, DFT and characterization strategy for latch-based structures.
– Drive custom macro development (multi-port register files, TCAM/CAM) from specification through layout, characterization and silicon validation.

• Custom & combo standard cells
– Mine synthesized ML netlists and cell-usage statistics to find custom cell opportunities — combo/complex cells, multi-bit flops, datapath compressors and MAC-optimized cells, ganged buffers, clock and power-management cells.
– Write cell specifications and work hands-on with circuit and layout engineers on topology, sizing, pin access, routability and DFM.
– Take custom cells through characterization, view generation, QA and PnR enablement, and quantify the block-level PPA benefit.

• Characterization & signoff views
– Own characterization strategy and quality for all foundation IP: Liberty (NLDM, CCS, ECSM), LVF/POCV, CCS noise and power, EM limits, LEF/abstracts and Verilog models.
– Set PVT corner strategy, including low-voltage and overdrive corners, with Physical Design, signoff and Product Engineering.
– Drive characterization flows (Synopsys PrimeLib/SiliconSmart, Cadence Liberate) and view QA (e.g., Siemens Solido Crosscheck), with SPICE correlation in Synopsys PrimeSim/HSPICE and Cadence Spectre.

• Foundry DTCO & node enablement
– Engage the foundry from early PDK versions on DTCO, cell architecture, design rules and device options for N3, N2 and below nodes.
– Work with others to define silicon characterization plans for libraries and memories (Vmin, speed, leakage, aging, self-heating) and correlate silicon to models, on both testchips and/or products.
– Track device and reliability model updates across PDK revisions and assess their impact on IP and product PPA.

• Team leadership
– Hire, develop and lead a small team to deliver on the above; set technical direction, review designs, and raise the bar on quality and execution.
– Report IP health, risks and PPA metrics to senior leadership through clear, data-driven narratives and decision documents.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of people management, managing engineers experience
- • BS in Electrical or Computer Engineering with 12+ years, MS with 10+ years, or PhD with 7+ years of experience in standard cell, memory or custom digital circuit design
- • Hands-on transistor-level design experience across standard cells, sequentials/latches, and SRAM or register files in FinFET or GAA technologies at 5nm or below
- • Experience as the technical interface to foundation IP vendors or foundries — specifying deliverables and driving SOWs, schedules, ECOs and IP quality
- • Experience evaluating standard cell library and memory PPA using block-level synthesis and place-and-route
- • Experience with standard cell and memory characterization and EDA views (Liberty/LVF, LEF, Verilog) using Synopsys PrimeLib/SiliconSmart or Cadence Liberate
- • Proficiency with custom design and verification tools: Cadence Virtuoso or Synopsys Custom Compiler; Spectre or HSPICE/PrimeSim; Siemens Calibre or Synopsys ICV
- • Scripting experience in Python, Tcl, Perl or SKILL

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
- • Experience on N3, N2 or below technologies, including backside power delivery and mixed-height standard cell libraries
- • Design or integration of latch-based arrays, custom multi-port register files, or TCAM/CAM for high-performance processors or ML accelerators
- • Track record defining custom and combo cells (multi-bit flops, complex/fused cells, datapath compressors) from netlist analytics, with measured block-level PPA gains
- • Memory design depth: bitcell options, read/write assist, Vmin, redundancy/repair, MBIST/BISR, low-power modes, and memory EM/IR analysis (Ansys Totem, Cadence Voltus-XFi)
- • Test chip definition, silicon characterization and model-to-silicon correlation, including aging, self-heating and EM reliability
- • GPIO, ESD, eFuse/OTP and on-die PVT sensor IP selection and integration
- • Working knowledge of physical design and signoff flows: Fusion Compiler, Innovus, PrimeTime, Tempus, StarRC, Quantus, RedHawk-SC
- • Experience on AI/ML accelerator or high-performance SoC programs taken to high-volume production
- • Demonstrated ability to influence external partners and make high-judgment tradeoffs under ambiguity
- • Demonstrated alignment with Amazon’s Leadership Principles at the Sr. Manager bar
- • Functional and technical depth consistent with the scope and complexity of this role

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Operations Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. title: Account Manager, Startups
descriptionHtml:
Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all by giving founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world’s largest companies. With nearly 20 years experience gained from supporting hundreds of thousands of startups that have come before, we help founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible, at any stage of growth or level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, build on AWS.

As AWS continues to rapidly grow, we seek a Startup Account Manager to earn trust and help drive growth amongst a set of well-funded, high-potential startups.

Startups represent a critically important subset of customers to AWS. These companies have unique needs, technical considerations, sales cycles, and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional companies. These businesses require different engagement strategies and sales motions from sellers to effectively acquire, grow, and retain them on the AWS platform long-term.

The ideal candidate possesses strong sales acumen, knowledge of the startup ecosystem, and a passion for (and familiarity with) Cybersecurity. You will be working with startups building innovative solutions, so extensive collaboration with both external and internal teams will be key to build and execute on plans to meet and exceed sales quota. Your responsibilities will include driving revenue, accelerating innovation through service adoption, and ensuring these startups select AWS as their primary cloud provider. You will work closely with product and service teams, business development, marketing, solution architecture and partner teams to drive customer outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
Ensure customer success with early and mid stage startups
Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory or industry vertical
Accelerate customer adoption through well-developed sales engagements and successful GTM Strategy
Meet or exceed quarterly revenue and goal targets.
Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.
Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services.
Accelerate customer adoption by engaging Founders, CxO, Board of Directors and VC influencers
Work with partners to extend reach & drive adoption.
Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.
Expect moderate travel.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Duales Studium - Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Du möchtest verstehen, wie Roboter, Sensoren und automatisierte Anlagen zusammenspielen?

Bei Amazon setzt du dein Wissen direkt in der Praxis ein. Du arbeitest an Anlagen, die Produkte durch eines der komplexesten Logistiknetzwerke der Welt bewegen. Vom ersten Tag an übernimmst du Verantwortung, arbeitest Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers und siehst den direkten Einfluss deiner Arbeit.

Als Teil von Amazon eröffnet sich dir ein Universum an Möglichkeiten: Zugang zu modernster Technik, vielfältige Karrierewege und ein Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen zählen und du früh gefördert und gefordert wirst.

Während des dualen Studiums besuchst du die Hochschule, um einen Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) mit Vertiefung Automatisierungstechnik zu erwerben. In einem Trainingszentrum erhältst du eine praktische Grundausbildung, und bei Amazon wendest du dein Wissen direkt an, an der Seite von erfahrenen Automation Engineers, die dich fördern und fordern.

Dabei entwickelst du Kenntnisse in Elektronik und Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Programmierung sowie Automatisierungs- und Steuerungstechnik. Gleichzeitig tauchst du in Zukunftsthemen wie Robotik, Smart Systems und IoT ein.

Beginn: 01.08.2027
Standort: Grossenkneten
Hochschule: HAW Hamburg
Ausbildungszentrum: Siemens AG Hamburg

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Key job responsibilities
• Hardware Engineering und Konfiguration von Anlagen
• Inbetriebnahme komplexer Infrastruktursysteme
• Arbeit mit Automatisierungssystemen und Prozessvisualisierungen
• Intelligente Fabrikautomation mit Cloud-Konnektivität
• IoT-Anwendungen in der Gebäude- und Anlagentechnik
• Installation elektrischer Einrichtungen
• Prüfung von elektrischen, pneumatischen und hydraulischen Steuerungen
• Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers und technischen Teams an realen Projekten

A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du an der Hochschule sowie in einem Trainingszentrum, während du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon an deinem Standort erwirbst.

Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers eine Störung an einer Förder- oder Sortieranlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. An einem anderen Tag konfigurierst du eine Steuerung und nimmst neue Technik in Betrieb. Und dann gibt es die Tage, an denen du an einem Projekt rund um Robotik, Sensorik oder IoT mitarbeitest.

Kein Tag ist wie der andere – mal stehst du an der Anlage, mal suchst du Fehler vor Ort, mal analysierst und optimierst du Systeme am Computer.

Du arbeitest von Anfang an mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers zusammen, lernst von ihnen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Du probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

- Allgemeine Hochschulreife, Fachhochschulreife / fachgebundene Hochschulreife
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1-Niveau)

- Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Elektro-/ Automatisierungs-/ Steuerungstechnik oder verwandten Bereichen

title: Senior Security Engineer, Special Projects
descriptionHtml:
Innovators wanted! Are you an entrepreneur? A builder? A dreamer? This role is part of an Amazon Special Projects team that takes the company’s Think Big leadership principle to the extreme. We focus on creating entirely new products and services with a goal of positively impacting the lives of our customers. No industries or subject areas are out of bounds. We launched products such as Comprehend Medical, Echo Frames and Amazon Explore. If you’re interested in innovating at scale to address big challenges in the world, this is the team for you.

As the Sr. Security Engineer, you will own the end-to-end threat model and translate it into concrete engineering deliverables: hardware attestation for compute nodes, encrypted workload delivery, result integrity verification, API authentication, and workload isolation guarantees. You will work across every component — reviewing the runtime's sandbox model, the scheduler's trust assumptions, the API surface, and the network layer's encryption — to ensure the system is secure by design.

Key job responsibilities
- Author the threat model for the platform architecture, identifying attack surfaces across compute nodes, network transit, and the control plane.
- Design and implement the attestation flow that verifies node integrity before workloads are dispatched, leveraging TPM/TEE where available and defining fallback assurance levels.
- Specify and validate encrypted workload delivery, ensuring model weights and inference inputs/outputs are protected at rest and in transit.
- Build result integrity verification mechanisms, conduct security reviews, lead penetration test preparation, and author compliance documentation.

About the team
Amazon Special Projects is building distributed infrastructure that operates across compute environments Amazon does not fully control. That sentence alone should tell you why this role matters. You will design the trust model that makes this architecture viable: ensuring that workloads are protected, results are verifiable, and the platform meets a bar that earns the confidence of internal and external customers. Security is not a layer we bolt on — it is a constraint that shapes every design decision from day one.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of at least two of the following programming languages: Scala, Java, Python, C/C++, or Go
- Experience (non-internship) in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating complex tasks using command line tools
- Experience (non-internship) in industry-based security vulnerabilities identification, attack patterns, and remediation techniques
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Experience with threat modeling and penetration testing, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities and experience in Linux and Networking protocols
- Deep expertise in hardware attestation (TPM, TEE, secure enclaves) and cryptographic protocols
- 7+ years of experience in security engineering, with at least 3 years focused on systems or infrastructure security
- Strong understanding of zero-trust architectures and their practical implementation
- Experience with secure API design, authentication, and authorization frameworks

Preferred qualifications

- Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques or equivalent
- Knowledge of cloud computing services and deployment architecture
- Experience performing technical audits/assessments in direct support of a major compliance effort (e.g., ISO, NIST, SOX, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR and other regulatory/industry certifications)
- Experience securing edge or distributed platforms where hardware is not under direct organizational control
- Background in secure enclave programming (Intel SGX, ARM TrustZone, or AWS Nitro Enclaves)
- Familiarity with ML model protection, including model watermarking or obfuscation techniques
- Published research or patents in applied cryptography, remote attestation, or secure computation

Fauna uses simulation to train robots, evaluate their behavior, and develop new capabilities before deploying them in the real world. We’re looking for a Simulation Software Engineer to build the environments, tools, and systems that make this possible—from generating diverse virtual worlds to testing robot behavior and running simulation at scale.

You’ll partner with scientists, robotics engineers, and technical artists to expand what robots can experience in simulation and what our teams can build with it. Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

Key job responsibilities
- Safety & compliance: Own your team's safety culture. Conduct daily safety walks, ensure all associates follow personal protective equipment and ergonomic standards, and address hazards immediately. Lead initiatives to reduce product damage and shipping defects.
- Shift management: Plan and assign work across your team to meet daily volume targets and shipping deadlines. Monitor real-time performance dashboards, adjust staffing levels, and reassign resources to close productivity gaps during your shift.
- Quality assurance: Audit packing accuracy, labeling compliance, and truck-loading standards. When defects arise, identify the root cause and implement corrective actions on the same shift.

A day in the life

Throughout the shift you walk the warehouse floor observing packing stations, checking throughput, and coaching associates in real time. You hold brief one-on-one conversations with associates about their performance and growth. At the end of the shift you hand off key metrics and open issues to the incoming manager. Your key stakeholders are the associates on your team, the senior manager you report to, and the downstream transportation network that depends on accurate, on-time shipments.

descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:

• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.

title: Sr. System Development Engineer, Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI)
descriptionHtml:
Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) Global Engineering is looking for a System Development Engineer (SysDE) to join our New Product Introduction (NPI) team. Our mission is to eliminate operational complexity at the source, ensuring every RDPI automation solution is designed for deployability, reliability, and maintainability from Day One.

As a SysDE III on the NPI team, you will embed with Hardware Development programs from the Alpha phase to influence controls and system architecture *before* solutions are built. Rather than fixing deployment and reliability problems in the field, you will design them out, shaping the automation, firmware, and integration decisions that determine how easily a solution scales across our global network. You are a technical leader who owns the controls architecture of the systems you support, decomposes ambiguous problems into clear workstreams, and partners with Hardware Development, Technical Program Managers, and the Scale and AI teams to deliver solutions that deploy themselves and run with minimal human intervention.

Key job responsibilities
- Embed with NPI programs from Alpha through GA, influencing controls and system architecture for deployability, reliability, and maintainability.
- Design standardized hardware/software interfaces and modular, reusable control patterns that reduce integration complexity across solutions.
- Build and validate automation and commissioning frameworks (CI/CD for controls code, automated configuration validation, emulators) in partnership with the Scale team.
- Lead reviews of architecture, design, and operations for your solutions, and contribute to reviews of partner-team systems.
- Partner with Hardware Development, TPMs, and the AI team to incorporate self-service deployment and predictive capabilities into solutions from inception.
- Mentor engineers, set engineering and operational excellence standards for the team, and contribute to the Operational Planning (OP) process.

A day in the life
You work across industrial control platforms (Codesys, Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Beckhoff) and the networked field devices, firmware, and cloud/WMS interfaces. You architect the controls software for a new solution, design reusable control patterns and contribute it to our libraries, write and review structured-text and automation-tooling code, and partner with Hardware to shape a system before it's built. Lead design reviews that surface architectural and scalability risks early, and prototype frameworks, emulators, automated validation, CI/CD for controls code that become the foundation future solutions are built on. You build and engineer solutions that are correct by design.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of at least one modern programming language such as C, C++, Java, or Perl
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- 5+ years of professional system development or controls engineering experience (or equivalent).
- Experience designing or architecting controls/automation systems for new or existing products, including making technical trade-offs.
- Hands-on experience with industrial control systems and PLC programming (e.g., Codesys, Allen-Bradley, Siemens, or Beckhoff) using Ladder Logic and/or Structured Text.
- Experience with industrial networking, system integration, and safety signal integration (e.g., E-Stops, I/O).

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with automation and any version control tools, or experience in software development and experience in deploying identity and access management systems
- Experience in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments, or experience working with Material handling equipment (MHE)
- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience managing teams
- Experience embedding with hardware or product development teams to influence design for deployment, reliability, or maintainability.
- Experience mentoring engineers and participating in technical reviews, hiring, or promotion assessments.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world leader in providing a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world!

Passionate about building, owning and operating massively scalable systems? Experienced in building and leading teams of highly competent software engineers? Want to make a billion-dollar impact? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you.

The Amazon Dedicated Cloud Engineering team is dedicated to building automated platforms and solutions to streamline the AWS build and deployment process in dedicated regions. Our vision is to fully automate and enable zero-touch AWS deployments thereby reducing the time it takes to deploy new features and freeing engineers to focus on building new services and capabilities.

Deployment engineering is a complex process requiring close collaboration with AWS service teams. We are looking for passionate innovators who want to take the challenge. title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Operações Logísticas, Amazon Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Esta é uma posição de tempo integral, permanente, presencial baseada em DAM1 - Manaus, BR e não oferece benefícios de realocação. Os candidatos devem estar localizados e legalmente autorizados a trabalhar em Brazil para serem elegíveis para consideração.

Você quer trabalhar duro, se divertir e fazer história? Se sim, a Amazon pode ser a escolha de carreira certa para você. Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.

As equipes de transporte da Amazon trabalham para garantir a entrega de pacotes para clientes em todo o mundo. Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.
A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Líder de Time para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil em nossa Delivery Station da região de Manaus/AM.

A Amazon está comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo. A Amazon é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e não discrimina com base em raça, origem nacional, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, status de veterano protegido, deficiência, idade ou outro status legalmente protegido.




Key job responsibilities
Como líder de equipe, você supervisionará uma de nossas estações de entrega, fornecendo liderança aos associados e gerenciando o desempenho dos principais indicadores – Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Você assumirá muitas funções e trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. A função envolve:

- Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega. Amazon lidera operações 24-7, e portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
- Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança em sua área de trabalho.
- Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
- Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com as diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.
- Fornecimento contínuo de informações críticas relacionadas ao turno aos operadores.
- Envolver-se com funções de suporte e/ou outros departamentos para abordar problemas ou necessidades comuns de indicadores de desempenho, por exemplo, processos de readiness, 5S, segurança, treinamento.
- Monitoramento do andamento das rotas, atuando de forma proativa para identificar e corrigir desvios e adequar, com foco na superação da expectativa do cliente e no gerenciamento dos custos de operação.
- Condução de reuniões, atribuição de funções e - trabalhar com KPIs como despacho pontual, sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia (On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success) e aprimoramento do atendimento ao cliente.
- Ficar obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para impulsionar as melhorias.
- Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
- Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento / implementação de sistemas / processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
- Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir as operações normais do dia a dia.
- Garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
- Comunicar as métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

Basic qualifications

- Ensino Superior completo
- Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários/turnos/áreas flexíveis, inclusive finais de semana, feriados e durante a madrugada.
- Experiência em gestão de pessoas
- Experiência em MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas).
- Inglês básico.

Preferred qualifications

- Excelente habilidade de comunicação com diferentes publicos.
- Graduação em Engenharia, Operações ou Experiência em operações/start-up/ambientes dinâmicos que lidam com ambiguidades

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- A Bachelor's degree or International Equivalent, OR 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience, OR 6+ years of Military Experience

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)
- Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Industry experience in: retail, F&B, military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production or distribution environments.

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Advertising Core Infra
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?

Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.

We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5× growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.

As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.

Key job responsibilities
- Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
- Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
- Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
- Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
- Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

A day in the life
- Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
- Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
- Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

About the team
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.

Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.

We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Procurement Executive, ATS Logistics Procurement
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you would like to help us build and scale the transportation network that moves products to customers across India, this is your chance to make history.

We are seeking a highly effective Procurement Executive with transportation procurement experience to optimize and streamline the carrier sourcing, contracting, and invoicing cycle. The person in this role will coordinate with several teams across Amazon and will interact directly with our carrier partners to satisfy organizational requirements. This role partners with internal business owners and key stakeholders to onboard carriers, execute and manage contracts across multiple transportation verticals (standard transportation, AMXL last mile, air, and rail), run the self-invoicing cycle, and maintain rate cards for the region. The position will work with multiple teams to develop, analyse, and identify areas of improvement, and roll out new processes to drive the right input at each stage. A working understanding of carrier management, rate negotiation, invoicing, and internal Amazon system workflows will be key to resolving and mitigating issues.

Key job responsibilities
The candidate is required to coordinate carrier procurement, contracting, and self-invoicing work across transportation verticals . The Procurement Executive will be responsible for setting up the right processes to meet the KPIs and metrics defined for this role, and for maintaining accurate trackers across all carriers and lanes in the region. The key responsibilities are listed below:

1) Onboard and set up carrier partners for transportation, including supporting expansion of the carrier base into newer segments such as quick commerce.
2) Execute and manage contracts across transportation verticals: standard transportation, AMXL last mile, air, and rail.
3) Run the self-invoicing cycle, including manual rate negotiation and closure for carriers on a fixed fortnightly cadence.
4) Prepare and distribute self-invoicing reports for the team and manage distribution of VRIDs at scale.
5) Handle carrier invoicing disputes end to end, ensuring smooth operational continuity.
6) Maintain and update rate cards, rate card addendums, and supporting documentation with accuracy and consistency.
7) Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and trackers for carriers, rates, and invoices.
8) Identify and drive process improvements and automation opportunities to reduce manual effort, cut processing time, and remove operational backlogs.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
- Experience in a procurement organization performing vendor management, contract management, negotiating complex purchases, and bidding
- Knowledge of purchase orders and invoice payments
- Experience in negotiation and selling
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- Experience in computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, macros, SQL, visualization tools - Tableau, Quicksight, etc.
- Experience in transportation operations and industry knowledge

title: Installation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

Physical Requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- High School diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+)
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. title: Software Development Engineer - Security Automation, AWS Security Epoxy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: System Development Engineer II, Imperium Data Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is looking for an experienced Systems Development Engineer to join the Imperium Data Services team in Austin. Data Services owns the source-of-truth data behind network automation across Amazon's fulfillment network: what devices exist, where they live, how they should be configured, which credentials they use, and what state they are actually in. Our services handle nearly a billion API calls a month and sit underneath config generation, deployment, and lifecycle workflows for hundreds of thousands of IP-enabled devices across thousands of sites. When our data is wrong, networks break; when it is right and fast, the rest of automation can run with confidence.

In this role you will partner with software, systems, and network engineers around the world to build and operate the data layer that network automation depends on. You will work on high-throughput APIs and data stores, collection of live device state, data pipelines, and the validation and staging gates that stop bad data before it reaches production devices. Network engineers and automation teams rely on the accuracy of what we serve. Your work will let them get answers in seconds and spend their time on hard problems instead of manual data cleanup. We value correctness, simplicity, and operational excellence in our designs.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Development Engineer on Data Services, you will design, build, and operate highly available services that model network devices, sites, and credentials, serving thousands of requests per second to automation workflows across the fulfillment network. You will build systems that collect the observed state of devices, including hardware inventory, firmware, interfaces, and neighbors, compare it against intended state, and surface drift before it causes customer impact. You will own data quality end to end, from schema design and validation at write time to staged, reviewable data changes, data health monitoring, and alarms that catch bad data before it reaches device configurations. You will lead migrations of legacy data sources onto modern APIs without disrupting the dozens of downstream teams that depend on them. You will take part in on-call, drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions, and turn recurring operational pain into automation, using AWS (CDK, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, OpenSearch) and CI/CD pipelines to automate infrastructure and deployments.

Ideal candidates enjoy working where distributed systems meet network data. You communicate clearly, turn ambiguous requirements into simple, durable designs, and care as much about how a service runs in production as how it is built. You will work in a fast-moving, collaborative environment with partner teams who depend on your systems every day.

A day in the life
You will be a part of an agile development team following innovative best practices in software development where you will work on technical designs, architecture and coding. To build our applications, you will interact with network engineering teams to gather requirements, provide technical solutions and develop the software that are required in defining our next generation products.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that assist you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!



About the team
Our team exists so that network engineers and automation teams can trust the data that runs Amazon's fulfillment network. We own the systems of record for network devices, sites, and credentials, plus the systems that observe what is actually running on devices in the field. Config generation, deployments, and lifecycle workflows across Imperium are all built on these services. We are accountable for making that data correct, fast, and safe to change, and we start from the customer: every bad record we prevent is an outage a network engineer never has to debug. As part of Data Services, you will work with automation, network engineering, and build teams across Amazon, and you will own your systems end to end, from design through operating them in production for hundreds of thousands of devices.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 2+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building services using AWS products
- Experience with distributed systems at scale
- Experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering
