- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

title: Sr. Associate - Quality Analyst, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate- Quality Analyst is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

Skills:
• Proficiency in verbal & written communication in English
• Good working knowledge of MS Office, MS Outlook; MS Excel. Proficiency is an advantage.
• Strong attention to details.
• Ability to analyze and identify patterns in large data sets.
• Decision making aptitudes based on given guidelines and in ambiguous contexts.
• Must be comfortable working with large data sets.
• Very good knowledge and experience in internet navigation and research – finding specific information about products in a timely manner.

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Direct Connect
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the software that connects the world's largest enterprises to the AWS cloud? Would you like to own distributed systems that keep a global network running, and use AI to change how that network is operated?

The AWS Direct Connect team delivers solutions that make it easy for customers to establish a dedicated network connection from their premises to the AWS cloud. AWS Direct Connect is available in more than 150 locations across more than 45 countries, and it connects AWS to our largest customers in data centers around the world.

We are building a new software engineering team in Dublin, working side by side with the Direct Connect network engineering team in the same office. You will build and operate the systems that keep Direct Connect customers healthy: data pipelines that analyze network traffic at scale to spot when a customer's traffic is degraded, services that identify which customers are impacted by a network event and keep them informed, and AI agents that automate how engineers handle operational tickets. Your work will help us find and resolve customer issues faster, and free engineers from repetitive operational work.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate services and asynchronous workflows across all AWS regions and Direct Connect locations.
- Build data processing, monitoring services, and automation that help us detect customer impact during events and resolve it faster.
- Troubleshoot and root-cause customer-impacting issues, and drive deep dives and corrective actions to completion.
- Partner with network development engineers to automate repeatable operational work, using AI-assisted development and agent-driven workflows.
- Write and review design documents, and mentor engineers through design and code reviews.

A day in the life
On a typical day, you might root-cause a customer-reported issue that spans our services and the network, whiteboard a workflow design with a senior engineer, or pair with a network engineer to automate a task they do by hand today. You'll collaborate with software and network engineers in Dublin and the US on system design. On-call rotations give you direct exposure to how your services and the network behave in production at AWS scale. Expect a mix of heads-down building and collaborative design sessions.

We prioritize availability and invest heavily in deployment safety and monitoring. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blueprint at our scale, so engineers have the autonomy to drive technical decisions and own the results. descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building data infrastructure that delivers real business value at massive scale? As a Data Engineer at Amazon, you will design, build, and optimize data pipelines and architectures that transform raw data into actionable insights. You will work alongside software engineers, data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to create reliable, performant data solutions that power critical decision-making. This is an opportunity to tackle complex data challenges, shape how information flows across systems, and directly influence outcomes through the quality and accessibility of the data products you deliver.

Key job responsibilities

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing pipeline health and data quality metrics, then shift into building or refining ETL workflows that serve downstream analytics and machine learning use cases. You might pair with a data scientist to design a new feature dataset, join a design review to evaluate a proposed architecture change, or mentor a teammate on data modeling patterns. You will regularly engage in code reviews, contribute to team planning, and collaborate across functions to keep data solutions aligned with evolving business priorities.

About the team
Our team is committed to making data accessible, reliable, and valuable across Amazon Ads. We build the foundational data infrastructure that enables analysts, scientists, and engineers to make informed decisions at scale. We operate in a collaborative environment where engineers take meaningful ownership of their domains and contribute to shared standards that raise the bar for everyone. If you are excited about solving complex data problems, working with curious and motivated colleagues, and growing your technical impact, we would love to hear from you.

- Experience building/operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets

title: Software Development Engineer II, Alexa Connectivity Devices
descriptionHtml:
We are building a new device software team in Bangalore to power the next generation of Amazon connected devices. As an OS / Kernel Engineer, you will own the foundational operating system layer — Linux kernel, device drivers, RTOS, and bootloaders — on which all device software depends. You will optimize for boot time, memory footprint, and power efficiency on resource-constrained hardware, and partner with SoC vendors on low-level platform enablement.



Key job responsibilities
Develop and maintain Linux kernel configurations, device drivers, and board support packages (BSPs)

Optimize boot time, memory footprint, and power consumption at the OS level

Implement and maintain bootloader chains (U-Boot, custom) with secure boot support

Port and adapt RTOS components (FreeRTOS, Zephyr) for companion microcontrollers

Debug kernel panics, race conditions, memory leaks, and other low-level system issues

Collaborate with SoC vendors on kernel patches, errata workarounds, and BSP updates

Own kernel upgrade strategy and long-term support (LTS) branch management

A day in the life
As a member of the team, you will serve as the technical leader for device software development and operations. You will collaborate with stakeholders across Alexa Devices and Alexa Cloud teams to define roadmaps, plan requirements, make prioritization trade-offs, and feature development. You will partner with principal engineers to brainstorm solutions, solve problems, and deliver features.


About the team
The Alexa Connected Devices team delivers low-latency, low-cost, highly reliable, and scalable connectivity between Alexa-enabled devices and the Alexa Cloud. We improve the speed and reliability of customer interactions with Alexa while simplifying the developer experience by abstracting connection management. Our services handle tens of billions of transactions daily. This is a highly visible role spanning inception, feature development, and partnering closely with tier-1 Cloud Services. The ideal candidate is passionate about Alexa and thrives delivering high-quality device capabilities in a hyper-growth environment.

Basic qualifications

title: Health and Safety Auditor, AWS Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
For more than 14 years, Amazon Web Services (AWS) has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud computing platform. What is cloud computing? Cloud computing is the on-demand delivery of IT resources over the Internet. Instead of buying, owning, and maintaining physical data centers and servers, companies can access technology services, such as computing power, storage, and databases, on an as-needed basis from AWS. AWS offers over 175 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence, Internet of Things, mobile, security, hybrid, virtual and augmented reality, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 77 Availability Zones across 24 geographic regions. AWS services are trusted by millions of active customers around the world - including the fastest-growing start-ups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—to power their infrastructure, make them more agile, and lower costs. To learn more about AWS, visit https://aws.amazon.com.

The AWS EHS team is an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth around the world, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS’s global operations, including physical data centers, as well as other AWS facilities, customer-facing enterprises and products. The EHS team has responsibility for architecting and implementing AWS’s global environmental and safety programs. This includes defining and implementing risk management and compliance systems and driving their continuous improvement; setting and refining global policies and procedures; overseeing the development of standards, tools, auditing and metrics, and employee training; ensuring effective engagement by environmental and health & safety teams on global initiatives, including those that are part of Amazon’s ambitious sustainability goals; providing specialist expertise; and engaging with all AWS business units to provide scalable and effective environmental and health & safety compliance strategies that support current and future business objectives while ensuring employee safety and compliance with environmental and health & safety regulations.

We are looking for a Health and Safety (H&S) Auditor who will be responsible for driving a systematic approach to delivering high-level, programmatic requirements of the AWS Safety Management Program (SMP), with a focus on defining the program structures, ownership, auditing mechanisms, policies and procedures necessary to formally measure, evaluate and improve individual and organizational H&S performance. The ideal candidate will be a highly motivated individual with a solid knowledge foundation in safety management systems, local and regional safety standards, and a proven track record of designing & improving safety programs & policies. They will have a history of building partnerships with diverse teams across multiple jurisdictions. The candidate must have the ability to define clear requirements in ambiguity, proactively educate team members, leaders, and other support teams, and communicate effectively and consistently throughout all levels of the business. The role will evolve with the maturity and growth of the SMP and requires a high degree of flexibility, including the ability to deep dive time critical programs, manage compliance assurance, and deliver continuous improvement actions.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities
- Plan and conduct audits of the SMP including on-site verification and remote assessments
- Develop programs, standards, tools, or best practice documentation reflective of regulatory requirements and current-state operations
- Support SMP initiatives and programs, including the initial communication and implementation of SMP
- Act as the subject matter expertise for SMP related questions
- Partner with local operational staff in communication, training, and execution of the SMP
- Provide timely communications to data center (DC) Operations leadership when needed
- Provide SMP program-level training and coaching to local operational staff to ensure technical competence across the region
- Follow up to ensure that corrective actions are implemented where necessary
- Act as a resource to field operations on regulatory compliance documentation to ensure accurate and up to date adherence to SMP requirements
- Implement and oversee SMP related performance metric reporting and communication
- Partner with DC support functions such as DC H&S, Legal, Engineering, Human Resources, Procurement, etc. to continuously capture opportunities for improvement, and facilitate the implementation of these improvements
- Act as a subject matter expert in safety and health standards, possess excellent safety program management skills, and be an effective communicator capable of sending clear, concise, and consistent messages both verbally and in writing.
- Travel estimated at 20-40%.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent
- Experience handling confidential information

Preferred qualifications

- Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
- Experience with SQL and Excel
- Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements

title: Advanced Manufacturing Engineer, Actuators
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Advanced Manufacturing Engineer to shape how our actuators, motors and gearboxes are built at scale. You will work with design engineering from early concept to make products easier to build, test and automate. You will help own the manufacturing concept for new products: process flow, factory layout, line balancing and the automation strategy. Detailed line and equipment design is handled by a separate team. You will hand them a defined, validated concept.

Key job responsibilities
- Help lead DFM, DFA and design-for-test reviews for actuators, motors and gearboxes, starting at the concept stage. Turn findings into specific design change requests and drive them to closure with design engineering.
- Influence product architecture (part count, assembly direction, fastening and joining methods, tolerance allocation) so it can be built on automated lines at volume.
- Help develop the manufacturing concept for each new product: process flow diagrams, station definitions, cycle time estimates, line balancing and factory layouts.
- Choose the automation level for each process step (manual, semi-automated or fully automated) and justify it with cost, quality, throughput and capital estimates.
- Define the in-process and end-of-line test strategy alongside design and quality engineering.
- Evaluate manufacturing equipment suppliers. Run concept studies, feasibility trials and proof-of-concept builds with them. Stay engaged through equipment buy-off and start of production.
- Identify the highest-risk processes early and reduce that risk with experiments, prototype builds and supplier trials before detailed line design begins.
- Write the requirements and concept package that the detailed line design team uses to build the line.
- Develop new assembly and test methods where standard industry processes do not meet cost, quality or rate targets.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 5+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in automated production environments
- Experience with DFM/DFA work that changed product design toward a more scalable, manufacturable architecture
- Experience working with manufacturing equipment suppliers from concept and quoting through equipment buy-off and start of production
- Proficiency with 3D CAD for part, assembly and layout work
- Experience with automation equipment such as robots, PLC-controlled stations, presses, dispensing systems or vision systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience creating process flow diagrams, factory layouts and line balancing for new products
- Expertise in one or more analyses relevant to electromechanical products, such as thermal modeling, FEA or magnetics
- Experience with Design of Experiments (DOE)
- Experience with electric motor manufacturing processes (stator winding, magnet insertion and bonding, rotor balancing, impregnation)
- Experience designing or manufacturing one or more gearbox or actuator types: planetary, cycloidal, strain wave, or linear actuators (ball screw or roller screw)
- Experience with precision assembly: bearing installation, press fits, adhesive dispensing and curing
- Experience defining end-of-line test for motors or actuators (back-EMF, torque ripple, NVH)
- Experience with PFMEA and process capability studies
- Experience with robotic assembly and machine vision
- Experience launching high-volume electromechanical products in automotive (EV traction motors), consumer electronics or similar industries

title: Investigations Analyst, Safety, NAST
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in working on a fast-paced team that pioneers ways to improve safety and compliance within North American Surface Transportation (NAST)? Do you enjoy digging into the details of an event and tracing it across multiple systems until you have a clear answer? Are you motivated by challenging problems where the answer isn't handed to you?
Amazon's NAST Safety & Compliance team, within Middle Mile Investigations (MMI), is seeking a detail-oriented Investigations Analyst to determine whether Amazon loads, equipment, or carrier relationships were involved in reported safety events across our carrier programs: Relay Marketplace Carrier (RMC), RMC LineHaul (RMCLH), RMC Box Truck (RMCBT), and Amazon Freight Partner (AFP).
Working within established investigation workflows and SOPs, with periodic review and guidance from the Program Manager, you'll review source documents such as police and crash reports, then match what they show (trailer and tractor plates, DOT numbers, carrier and driver details) against internal load, assignment, and location records. Each event ends in a clear, documented determination of whether Amazon had involvement, backed by the evidence behind it. Along the way you'll spot issues that need follow-up, such as events that were never reported, or loads moved by a carrier other than the one assigned, and route them to the right partner teams. An ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, has strong attention to detail, is vocally self-critical, and collaborates well in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.


Key job responsibilities
Investigation
• Conduct assigned incident investigations from intake through documented finding across RMC, RMCLH, RMCBT, and AFP, determining whether an Amazon load, asset, or carrier relationship was involved.
• Collect and preserve evidence including telematics, dash-camera footage, law enforcement and crash reports, and carrier documentation.
• Match physical evidence (trailer/tractor plates, DOT numbers, carrier and driver details) against load, assignment, and location records.
• Apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria and video review standards.
• Write clear investigation narratives documenting what occurred and the factors identified, with every line sourced to verifiable data, so partner teams can act without re-investigating.
• Serve as a point of contact on assigned incidents to internal stakeholders.
Analysis & escalation
• Identify events needing follow-up (unreported incidents, mis-assigned loads) and route them to the appropriate partner teams.
• Query and reconcile data across multiple transportation systems to support investigations.
• Identify trends across regions, carrier programs, and individual carriers, and surface them to the Program Manager.
• Recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices for Program Manager review.
Operating rhythm & process improvement
• Work a steady queue of cases against turnaround expectations, keeping case records and queue status current and auditable in the systems of record.
• Review recurring vendor investigation reports for completeness and escalate vendor performance issues.
• Report investigation status, closure metrics, and case aging to the Program Manager on a recurring cadence.
• Flag recurring data or process gaps that slow investigations, and propose improvements to investigation standard work and SOPs.


A day in the life
Your morning starts with the queue: new incidents overnight, open evidence requests, cases aging. You pull telematics and video on an assigned collision and chase the law enforcement report and carrier documentation. By afternoon you are writing the narrative, sourcing every line. Some events bring outside counsel into the file, and you are the person who knows what happened. A pattern you flagged last month across two regions becomes a recommendation your Program Manager takes to an enforcement decision. No two investigations are the same, and what you document today shapes what the network changes next quarter.

About the team
Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) sits within NAST Safety & Compliance. We investigate transportation incidents across Amazon's Middle Mile carrier programs, document what happened from verifiable evidence, and surface patterns that inform how the network operates. The team is geographically distributed, and the written product carries to senior leaders who act on it. If you enjoy detailed problem-solving and are comfortable with ambiguity, you'll do well here.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 2+ years of professional or military experience
- 2+ years of experience working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with investigations, auditing, risk management, compliance, or safety

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in a business analyst, data analyst, or equivalent role
- Experience with end-to-end project management

title: Manufacturing Engineer, Amazon Manufacturing Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Manufacturing Services (AMS) is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to join our advanced manufacturing team. This role will be embedded across AMS manufacturing sites, whether operational, expanding, or launching, supporting scaled manufacturing for Amazon. The Manufacturing Engineer will focus on new product introduction (NPI), manufacturing process development, and machinery/equipment selection, ensuring AMS sites are equipped with the right processes and technologies to meet quality, throughput, and cost targets. The role will partner cross-functionally with product engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to evaluate and implement new manufacturing technologies, define process requirements for new and evolving product lines, and drive continuous improvement across production operations. The ideal candidate will also contribute to Design for Manufacturability (DFM) reviews, providing practical manufacturing feedback during the design cycle, while placing primary focus on standing up and optimizing the processes, equipment, and capabilities needed to scale production at AMS facilities.

Key job responsibilities
New Product & Process Introduction — Support manufacturing process development for new products from prototype through production ramp, including defining process flows, work instructions, tooling requirements, and acceptance criteria for scaled manufacturing.

Machinery & Equipment Selection — Participate in capital equipment evaluation, selection, specification, and commissioning activities, including supporting business cases, conducting vendor assessments, and assisting with installation and qualification at AMS manufacturing sites.

Manufacturing Technology & Automation Evaluation — Research and recommend advanced manufacturing technologies and automation solutions (robotics, vision systems, automated material handling, and fixtured/cell-based automation) that improve throughput, quality, and cost performance across AMS operations.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement — Analyze existing production lines to identify bottlenecks, reduce cycle times, optimize setups, and increase capacity using data-driven methods and lean manufacturing principles.

Design for Manufacturability (DFM) — Provide manufacturing engineering input during product design reviews, ensuring components and assemblies are practical to produce at scale with target quality and cost outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work with product engineering, operations, supply chain, and site launch teams to resolve manufacturing challenges, align on process requirements, and support site expansions and new site launches.

Process Control & Quality Systems — Develop and implement process control strategies, quality plans, and inspection methodologies to ensure consistent production output across technologies.

Site Launch & Expansion Support — Provide hands-on manufacturing engineering support for new site launches and capacity expansions, including equipment layout, line balancing, and production readiness assessments.

Documentation & PLM Management — Utilize PLM systems to manage product data, engineering changes, and manufacturing documentation throughout the product development lifecycle.

About the team
Manufacturing Systems Engineering owns the design, build, and continuous improvement of Amazon's advanced manufacturing facilities. We are the engineering team responsible for transforming manufacturing concepts into operational reality, from facility layout and workstation design to process optimization and equipment integration. Our scope spans new facility launches and ongoing expansion and improvement of existing manufacturing operations, supporting advanced manufacturing and assembly of material handling and light industrial equipment for Amazon's fulfillment network. The team is in a high-growth phase, with significant opportunity to help shape manufacturing design standards and scalable solutions that will define how Amazon builds and operates its manufacturing capabilities.

Basic qualifications

title: Spacecraft Design CAD, Mech Engineer, Configuration Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We’re working on the future. If you are seeking an iterative, fast-paced environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real-world challenges, and provide visible benefit to end-users, this is your opportunity.

We’re looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer who combines superb 3D CAD capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right work done quickly and effectively. This person must have experience working in a multidisciplinary environment and producing top-notch CAD designs for spacecraft-class hardware. This person must be comfortable working with large databases with complex constraints—managing the full lifecycle of mechanical design data from concept through production release within Siemens NX and Teamcenter.

You will be embedded within a team of engineers driving the mechanical design of satellite systems—translating engineering intent into production-ready CAD models, drawings, and BOMs that flow cleanly through our product lifecycle management infrastructure. Your work directly enables the velocity of satellite development and production.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• CAD Design Creation & Management: Create, iterate, and manage CAD designs for large spacecraft system databases; maintain model integrity across complex assemblies with hundreds of interdependent components
• Drawing Production & Release: Manage the creation, checking, issuing, and revision of engineering drawings for parts and assemblies—ensuring compliance with Leo drawing standards and GD&T best practices
• BOM Lifecycle Management: Manage CAD BOM through the product lifecycle management system (Teamcenter); ensure BOM accuracy from design through release to manufacturing
• Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Work with a team of engineers across multiple disciplines—mechanical, thermal, electrical, structural, manufacturing, metrology, tooling, assembly, and test—in the ideation and creation of system concepts
• Supplier & Vendor Interface: Engage with suppliers and vendors as needed for CAD definition of sourced components and systems; develop procurement-ready technical data packages
• Manufacturing Source Review: Work with procurement and sourcing in identification and review of manufacturing sources; ensure designs are optimized for producibility
• Configuration Control: Support change management workflows, revision control, and design data integrity within the PLM ecosystem
• Database Organization: Maintain CAD database organization, naming conventions, and file management standards to enable team-wide efficiency at scale

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or 1+ years of electrical or mechanical engineering experience
- 3+ years of CAD experience in complex mechanical/electro-mechanical assemblies, machines, structures, or systems
- 1+ years of experience in the creation, manipulation, iteration, and optimization of mechanical designs with complex interactions and constraints
- 1+ years of experience interfacing with a range of engineering disciplines, and understanding the scope of those inputs and requirements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience prioritizing and delivering projects on time in a fast-moving environment
- Expert-level capability with Siemens NX (4+ years of experience in advanced CAD assemblies)
- Manufacturing and test knowledge (forming, machining, finishing, tooling, assembly, testing)
- Awareness of adhesives, finishes, material properties, and selection criteria that influence selection for harsh environments (space-grade thermal cycling, radiation, vacuum)
- Experience optimizing design features for part cost (material handling, manufacturing, finishing, measurement)
- Hands-on experience with manufacturers, machinists, and part producers
- Experience developing fabrication drawings for a range of manufacturing methods (rapid prototyping, machining, forming, composite manufacturing)
- Experienced in CAD database management, CAD Bill of Materials management, and Product Life Cycle Management (PLM) using Teamcenter
- Experience with change control and management through ERP/MRP systems to manufacturing/assembly personnel
- Hands-on support in prototyping, assembly, and test
- Excellent CAD database organization and management skills

title: Data Engineer II, Alexa AI - ML Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Join Alexa AI - ML Engineering and help power personalized, proactive experiences for hundreds of millions of Alexa customers worldwide. As a Data Engineer II, you will design and own the large-scale data pipelines that turn raw customer-interaction signals into the context and features our personalization and proactive-agent models depend on, working side-by-side with SDEs to shape our data strategy and architecture.

- You will build and operate ETL/ELT pipelines processing billions of records a day, using AWS big-data services (Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Redshift, DynamoDB) and distributed compute.
- You will partner with SDEs and applied scientists to define data strategy, contracts, and feature pipelines, and to decide architecture direction together.
- You will own operational health: data migrations, schema/platform updates, and triage of pipeline tickets, directly supporting the SDE team's work.
- This is a high-visibility role: the data you deliver, and keep running, directly shapes what Alexa proactively tells customers, and when.


Key job responsibilities
1. Partner closely with SDEs to help define data strategy, architecture direction, and the long-term roadmap for the team's data platform.
2. Design, build, and own ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and load customer-interaction and context data at a scale of billions of records per day.
3. Own operational items end-to-end: data migrations, schema and platform updates, and triage/resolution of data-pipeline tickets, providing day-to-day support to the SDE team.
4. Partner with applied scientists and ML engineers to define data contracts, feature pipelines, and data-quality checks feeding personalization and proactive-agent models.
5. Operate and continuously improve production pipelines: optimize data delivery, redesign for scalability, manage deployments, and drive root-cause fixes for pipeline incidents.
6. Establish and document best practices for data modeling, warehousing, and pipeline design across the team.

A day in the life
You'll join SDEs in a design discussion to shape data strategy and architecture, then pick up a migration or platform-update ticket and see it through to resolution. You'll trace a data-quality issue in a personalization feature pipeline, support SDEs with any operational asks on your pipelines, and monitor the health of systems processing billions of daily customer-interaction events. You'll partner with applied scientists to onboard new signal sources and triage pipeline alerts.

About the team
Alexa AI - ML Engineering builds the personalization and proactive-intelligence systems that let Alexa anticipate what customers need before they ask. Data Engineers work side-by-side with SDEs and applied scientists, combining data strategy and large-scale engineering to turn billions of daily customer-interaction signals into the context, features, and content that drive Alexa's ranking, personalization, and proactive-agent experiences. We value ownership, data quality, and working backwards from the customer.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of data engineering experience
- 4+ years of SQL experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

title: Application Security Engineer, AppSTAR
descriptionHtml:

title: Senior HR Business Partner, AMZL HR
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a highly motivated, gemba-oriented, scalable HR professional to join the growing INFC HR team. INFC is Amazon India's fulfillment center network, where customer orders are received, stored, picked, packed and shipped, and the network has grown in multiples over the past few years.

The Sr. HRBP, based on deep insight into what is happening on the Fulfillment Center floor, works with the senior management team to develop, implement and drive results that increase organizational effectiveness and efficiency.
